  42| |# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  43| |# Helpers
  44| |# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  46|▼|move() {
  47| |  local src="$1"
  48| |  local dest="$2"
  50| |  if [[ ! -e "$src" ]]; then
  51| |    echo "Skip move, missing: $src"
  52| |    return 0
  53| |  fi
  55| |  if [[ -e "$dest" ]]; then
  56| |    echo "Skip move, already exists: $dest"
  57| |    return 0
  58| |  fi
  60| |  if git rev-parse --git-dir >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  61| |    git mv "$src" "$dest"
  62| |  else
  63| |    mv "$src" "$dest"
  64| |  fi
  65| |}

 265| |# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 267| |echo "Replacing src/compiler/fp.ts with minimal FP core..."
 269| |cat > src/compiler/fp.ts <<'FLUX_EOF'
 270| |/**
 271| | * Minimal functional core used by the compiler.
 272| | *
 273| | * This intentionally removes unused utility-belt code and external dependencies.
 274| | * If you need debounce/throttle/memoize/retry, add them in a separate optional
 275| | * module and do not import them into core runtime paths.
 276| | */
 278| |export type Result<T, E = string> =
 279| |  | { readonly ok: true; readonly value: T }
 280| |  | { readonly ok: false; readonly error: E };
 282| |export const ok = <T>(value: T): Result<T, never> => ({ ok: true, value });
 284| |export const err = <E>(error: E): Result<never, E> => ({ ok: false, error });
 286| |export const isOk = <T, E>(r: Result<T, E>): r is { ok: true; value: T } => r.ok;
 288| |export const isErr = <T, E>(r: Result<T, E>): r is { ok: false; error: E } => !r.ok;
 290| |export const unwrapOr =
 291| |  <T>(fallback: T) =>
 292| |  (r: Result<T>): T =>
 293| |    r.ok ? r.value : fallback;
 295| |export const unwrapOrElse =
 296| |  <T, E>(fn: (e: E) => T) =>
 297| |  (r: Result<T, E>): T =>
 298| |    r.ok ? r.value : fn(r.error);
 300| |export const mapResult =
 301| |  <T, U>(fn: (x: T) => U) =>
 302| |  <E>(r: Result<T, E>): Result<U, E> =>
 303| |    r.ok ? ok(fn(r.value)) : r;
 305| |export const flatMapResult =
 306| |  <T, U, E>(fn: (x: T) => Result<U, E>) =>
 307| |  (r: Result<T, E>): Result<U, E> =>
 308| |    r.ok ? fn(r.value) : r;
 310| |export const mapErr =
 311| |  <E, F>(fn: (e: E) => F) =>
 312| |  <T>(r: Result<T, E>): Result<T, F> =>
 313| |    r.ok ? r : err(fn(r.error));
 315| |export const tryCatch = <T>(fn: () => T): Result<T, unknown> => {
 316| |  try {
 317| |    return ok(fn());
 318| |  } catch (error) {
 319| |    return err(error);
 320| |  }
 321| |};
 323| |export const tryCatchAsync = async <T>(fn: () => Promise<T>): Promise<Result<T, unknown>> => {
 324| |  try {
 325| |    return ok(await fn());
 326| |  } catch (error) {
 327| |    return err(error);
 328| |  }
 329| |};
 331| |export const tryCatchOr = <T>(fallback: T, fn: () => T): T => {
 332| |  try {
 333| |    return fn();
 334| |  } catch {
 335| |    return fallback;
 336| |  }
 337| |};
 339| |export type Task<T> = () => Promise<T>;
 341| |export const taskMap =
 342| |  <T, U>(fn: (x: T) => U) =>
 343| |  (task: Task<T>): Task<U> =>
 344| |  async () =>
 345| |    fn(await task());
 347| |export const taskChain =
 348| |  <T, U>(fn: (x: T) => Task<U>) =>
 349| |  (task: Task<T>): Task<U> =>
 350| |  async () =>
 351| |    fn(await task())();
 353| |export const taskFromResult =
 354| |  <T>(value: T): Task<T> =>
 355| |  async () =>
 356| |    value;
 358| |export const pipe =
 359| |  <A>(a: A) =>
 360| |  <B>(...fns: Array<(x: any) => any>): B =>
 361| |    fns.reduce((acc: any, fn) => fn(acc), a) as unknown as B;
 362| |FLUX_EOF
 364| |# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 365| |# Replace src/compiler/utils/hash.ts
 366| |# Keep only hashes actually used by analysis/codegen.
 367| |# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 369| |echo "Replacing src/compiler/utils/hash.ts..."
 371| |cat > src/compiler/utils/hash.ts <<'FLUX_EOF'
 372| |/**
 373| | * Hash utilities used by route analysis.
 374| | *
 375| | * Removed:
 376| | * - canUseDenseArray
 377| | * - generatePerfectHash
 378| | * - segmentHash
 379| | *
 380| | * These belonged to the unused jump-table optimizer path.
 381| | */
 383| |export const fnv1a = (str: string): number => {
 384| |  let hash = 0x811c9dc5;
 386| |  for (let i = 0; i < str.length; i++) {
 387| |    hash ^= str.charCodeAt(i);
 388| |    hash += (hash << 1) + (hash << 4) + (hash << 7) + (hash << 8) + (hash << 24);
 389| |  }
 391| |  return hash >>> 0;
 392| |};
 394| |export const computeSignatureHash = (methodIdx: number, path: string): number => {
 395| |  const pathHash = fnv1a(path);
 396| |  return ((methodIdx & 0x07) << 29) | (pathHash >>> 3);
 397| |};
 398| |FLUX_EOF

   1| |/**
   2| | * Minimal functional core used by the compiler.
   3| | *
   4| | * This intentionally removes unused utility-belt code and external dependencies.
   5| | * If you need debounce/throttle/memoize/retry, add them in a separate optional
   6| | * module and do not import them into core runtime paths.
   7| | */
   9|▼|export type Result<T, E = string> =
  10| |  | { readonly ok: true; readonly value: T }
  11| |  | { readonly ok: false; readonly error: E };
  13|▼|export const ok = <T>(value: T): Result<T, never> => ({ ok: true, value });
  15|▼|export const err = <E>(error: E): Result<never, E> => ({ ok: false, error });
  17| |export const isOk = <T, E>(r: Result<T, E>): r is { ok: true; value: T } => r.ok;
  19| |export const isErr = <T, E>(r: Result<T, E>): r is { ok: false; error: E } => !r.ok;
  21|▼|export const unwrapOr =
  22| |  <T>(fallback: T) =>
  23| |  (r: Result<T>): T =>
  24| |    r.ok ? r.value : fallback;
  26|▼|export const unwrapOrElse =
  27| |  <T, E>(fn: (e: E) => T) =>
  28| |  (r: Result<T, E>): T =>
  29| |    r.ok ? r.value : fn(r.error);
  31|▼|export const mapResult =
  32| |  <T, U>(fn: (x: T) => U) =>
  33| |  <E>(r: Result<T, E>): Result<U, E> =>
  34| |    r.ok ? ok(fn(r.value)) : r;
  36|▼|export const flatMapResult =
  37| |  <T, U, E>(fn: (x: T) => Result<U, E>) =>
  38| |  (r: Result<T, E>): Result<U, E> =>
  39| |    r.ok ? fn(r.value) : r;
  41|▼|export const mapErr =
  42| |  <E, F>(fn: (e: E) => F) =>
  43| |  <T>(r: Result<T, E>): Result<T, F> =>
  44| |    r.ok ? r : err(fn(r.error));
  46|▼|export const tryCatch = <T>(fn: () => T): Result<T, unknown> => {
  47| |  try {
  48| |    return ok(fn());
  49|!|  } catch (error) {
  50| |    return err(error);
  51| |  }
  52| |};
  54|▼|export const tryCatchAsync = async <T>(fn: () => Promise<T>): Promise<Result<T, unknown>> => {
  55| |  try {
  56| |    return ok(await fn());
  57|!|  } catch (error) {
  58| |    return err(error);
  59| |  }
  60| |};
  62|▼|export const tryCatchOr = <T>(fallback: T, fn: () => T): T => {
  63| |  try {
  64| |    return fn();
  65| |  } catch {
  66| |    return fallback;
  67| |  }
  68| |};
  70|▼|export type Task<T> = () => Promise<T>;
  72|▼|export const taskMap =
  73| |  <T, U>(fn: (x: T) => U) =>
  74| |  (task: Task<T>): Task<U> =>
  75| |  async () =>
  76| |    fn(await task());
  78|▼|export const taskChain =
  79| |  <T, U>(fn: (x: T) => Task<U>) =>
  80| |  (task: Task<T>): Task<U> =>
  81| |  async () =>
  82| |    fn(await task())();
  84|▼|export const taskFromResult =
  85| |  <T>(value: T): Task<T> =>
  86| |  async () =>
  87| |    value;
  89|▼|export const pipe =
  90| |  <A>(a: A) =>
  91| |  <B>(...fns: Array<(x: any) => any>): B =>
  92| |    fns.reduce((acc: any, fn) => fn(acc), a) as unknown as B;

   1| |/**
   2| | * @fileoverview Structured Logger
   3| | * All side-effecting I/O is centralized here. Compiler phases receive a Logger
   4| | * interface and remain pure except for logging calls.
   5| | */
   7|▼|export interface Logger {
   8| |  debug(msg: string, meta?: Record<string, unknown>): void;
   9| |  info(msg: string, meta?: Record<string, unknown>): void;
  10| |  warn(msg: string, meta?: Record<string, unknown>): void;
  11| |  error(msg: string, meta?: Record<string, unknown>): void;
  12| |  /** Time a phase and log duration. */
  13| |  time<T>(label: string, fn: () => T): T;
  14| |}
  16| |/** No-op logger for tests and silent mode. */
  17| |export const silentLogger: Logger = {
  18| |  debug: () => {},
  19| |  info: () => {},
  20| |  warn: () => {},
  21| |  error: () => {},
  22| |  time: (_, fn) => fn(),
  23| |};
  25| |/** Console logger with emoji prefixes and structured metadata. */
  26|▼|export const consoleLogger = (verbose = false): Logger => ({
  27| |  debug(msg, meta) {
  28| |    if (verbose) console.log(`[debug] ${msg}`, meta ?? "");
  29| |  },
  30| |  info(msg, meta) {
  31| |    console.log(`ℹ️  ${msg}`, meta ?? "");
  32| |  },
  33| |  warn(msg, meta) {
  34| |    console.warn(`⚠️  ${msg}`, meta ?? "");
  35| |  },
  36| |  error(msg, meta) {
  37| |    console.error(`❌ ${msg}`, meta ?? "");
  38| |  },
  39| |  time(label, fn) {
  40| |    const t0 = performance.now();
  41| |    const result = fn();
  42| |    const elapsed = (performance.now() - t0).toFixed(2);
  43| |    console.log(`⏱️  ${label} completed in ${elapsed}ms`);
  44| |    return result;
  45| |  },
  46| |});
  48| |/** Enterprise-grade JSON logger for CI/CD pipelines. */
  49|▼|export const jsonLogger = (verbose = false): Logger => ({
  50| |  debug(msg, meta) {
  51| |    if (verbose) console.log(JSON.stringify({ level: "debug", msg, ...meta }));
  52| |  },
  53| |  info(msg, meta) {
  54| |    console.log(JSON.stringify({ level: "info", msg, ...meta }));
  55| |  },
  56| |  warn(msg, meta) {
  57| |    console.log(JSON.stringify({ level: "warn", msg, ...meta }));
  58| |  },
  59| |  error(msg, meta) {
  60| |    console.log(JSON.stringify({ level: "error", msg, ...meta }));
  61| |  },
  62| |  time(label, fn) {
  63| |    const t0 = performance.now();
  64| |    const result = fn();
  65| |    const elapsed = (performance.now() - t0).toFixed(2);
  66| |    console.log(JSON.stringify({ level: "metric", phase: label, durationMs: parseFloat(elapsed) }));
  67| |    return result;
  68| |  },
  69| |});

>src/compiler/utils/hash.ts
e:fnv1a|computeSignatureHash
f:fnv1a(str: string):number
f:computeSignatureHash(methodIdx: number, path: string):number
---
   1| |/**
   2| | * Hash utilities used by route analysis.
   3| | *
   4| | * Removed:
   5| | * - canUseDenseArray
   6| | * - generatePerfectHash
   7| | * - segmentHash
   8| | *
   9| | * These belonged to the unused jump-table optimizer path.
  10| | */
  12|▼|export const fnv1a = (str: string): number => {
  13| |  let hash = 0x811c9dc5;
  15| |  for (let i = 0; i < str.length; i++) {
  16| |    hash ^= str.charCodeAt(i);
  17| |    hash += (hash << 1) + (hash << 4) + (hash << 7) + (hash << 8) + (hash << 24);
  18| |  }
  20| |  return hash >>> 0;
  21| |};
  23|▼|export const computeSignatureHash = (methodIdx: number, path: string): number => {
  24| |  const pathHash = fnv1a(path);
  25| |  return ((methodIdx & 0x07) << 29) | (pathHash >>> 3);
  26| |};

---
   1| |/**
   2| | * @fileoverview Lazy body parsing for production performance.
   3| | *
   4| | * Body parsing is deferred until actually needed.
   5| | * Uses Bun-native parsers:
   6| | * - req.json()
   7| | * - req.text()
   8| | * - req.formData()
   9| | * - req.arrayBuffer()
  10| | */
  12|▼|export class BodyParseError extends Error {
  13| |  constructor(
  14| |    message: string,
  15| |    public status = 400
  16| |  ) {
  17| |    super(message);
  18| |    this.name = "BodyParseError";
  19| |  }
  20| |}
  22|▼|export interface LazyBodyOptions {
  23| |  maxJsonBytes?: number;
  24| |  maxTextBytes?: number;
  25| |  maxFormBytes?: number;
  26| |  maxFileBytes?: number;
  27| |}
  29|▼|type BodyKind =
  30| |  | "none"
  31| |  | "json"
  32| |  | "text"
  33| |  | "formData"
  34| |  | "arrayBuffer"
  35| |  | "blob";
  37|▼|export interface LazyBody {
  38| |  (): Promise<unknown>;
  40| |  json<T = unknown>(): Promise<T>;
  41| |  text(): Promise<string>;
  42| |  form(): Promise<Record<string, string>>;
  43| |  multipart(): Promise<Record<string, unknown>>;
  44| |  formData(): Promise<FormData>;
  46| |  file(name?: string): Promise<File | null>;
  47| |  files(name?: string): Promise<File[]>;
  49| |  arrayBuffer(): Promise<ArrayBuffer>;
  50| |  blob(): Promise<Blob>;
  52| |  /**
  53| |   * Returns the raw request stream if the body has not been consumed.
  54| |   * Useful for proxying or streaming uploads downstream.
  55| |   */
  56| |  stream(): ReadableStream<Uint8Array> | null;
  58| |  readonly consumed: boolean;
  59| |  readonly parsed: unknown;
  60| |}
  62| |const DEFAULT_LIMITS = {
  63| |  maxJsonBytes: 2 * 1024 * 1024,
  64| |  maxTextBytes: 2 * 1024 * 1024,
  65| |  maxFormBytes: 2 * 1024 * 1024,
  66| |  maxFileBytes: 20 * 1024 * 1024,
  67| |};
  69|▼|function formDataToRecord(fd: FormData): Record<string, string> {
  70| |  const out: Record<string, string> = {};
  72| |  for (const [key, value] of fd) {
  73| |    if (typeof value === "string") {
  74| |      out[key] = value;
  75| |    } else {
  76| |      // For files, expose filename in form record.
  77| |      out[key] = value.name;
  78| |    }
  79| |  }
  81| |  return out;
  82| |}
  84|▼|function formDataToObject(fd: FormData): Record<string, unknown> {
  85| |  const out: Record<string, unknown> = {};
  87| |  for (const [key, value] of fd) {
  88| |    const existing = out[key];
  90| |    if (existing === undefined) {
  91| |      out[key] = value;
  92| |    } else if (Array.isArray(existing)) {
  93| |      existing.push(value);
  94| |    } else {
  95| |      out[key] = [existing, value];
  96| |    }
  97| |  }
  99| |  return out;
 100| |}
 102|▼|export function createLazyBody(
 103| |  req: Request,
 104| |  opts: LazyBodyOptions = {}
 105| |): LazyBody {
 106| |  const limits = {
 107| |    maxJsonBytes: opts.maxJsonBytes ?? DEFAULT_LIMITS.maxJsonBytes,
 108| |    maxTextBytes: opts.maxTextBytes ?? DEFAULT_LIMITS.maxTextBytes,
 109| |    maxFormBytes: opts.maxFormBytes ?? DEFAULT_LIMITS.maxFormBytes,
 110| |    maxFileBytes: opts.maxFileBytes ?? DEFAULT_LIMITS.maxFileBytes,
 111| |  };
 113| |  let kind: BodyKind = "none";
 114| |  let value: unknown;
 116| |  let pending: Promise<unknown> | null = null;
 117| |  let pendingKind: BodyKind | null = null;
 119|▼|  function assertSize(max?: number): void {
 120| |    if (!max) return;
 122| |    const len = Number(req.headers.get("content-length") || "0");
 123| |    if (Number.isFinite(len) && len > max) {
 124|!|      throw new BodyParseError("Payload too large", 413);
 125| |    }
 126| |  }
 128|▼|  function convert<T>(target: BodyKind): T {
 129| |    if (kind === target) return value as T;
 131| |    if (kind === "json") {
 132| |      const text = JSON.stringify(value);
 134| |      if (target === "text") return text as T;
 135| |      if (target === "arrayBuffer") {
 136| |        return new TextEncoder().encode(text).buffer as T;
 137| |      }
 138| |      if (target === "blob") {
 139| |        return new Blob([text], { type: "application/json" }) as T;
 140| |      }
 141| |    }
 143| |    if (kind === "text") {
 144| |      const text = value as string;
 146| |      if (target === "json") return JSON.parse(text) as T;
 147| |      if (target === "arrayBuffer") {
 148| |        return new TextEncoder().encode(text).buffer as T;
 149| |      }
 150| |      if (target === "blob") return new Blob([text]) as T;
 152| |      if (target === "formData") {
 153| |        const fd = new FormData();
 154| |        new URLSearchParams(text).forEach((v, k) => fd.append(k, v));
 155| |        return fd as T;
 156| |      }
 157| |    }
 159| |    if (kind === "arrayBuffer") {
 160| |      const buf = value as ArrayBuffer;
 161| |      const text = new TextDecoder().decode(buf);
 163| |      if (target === "text") return text as T;
 164| |      if (target === "json") return JSON.parse(text) as T;
 165| |      if (target === "blob") return new Blob([buf]) as T;
 166| |    }
 168| |    if (kind === "formData") {
 169| |      const fd = value as FormData;
 171| |      if (target === "text") {
 172| |        const params = new URLSearchParams();
 173| |        for (const [k, v] of fd) {
 174| |          if (typeof v === "string") params.append(k, v);
 175| |        }
 176| |        return params.toString() as T;
 177| |      }
 178| |    }
 180|!|    throw new BodyParseError(
 181| |      `Body already consumed as "${kind}"; cannot parse as "${target}".`,
 182| |      409
 183| |    );
 184| |  }
 186|▼|  async function use<T>(
 187| |    target: BodyKind,
 188| |    parser: () => Promise<T>,
 189| |    max?: number
 190| |  ): Promise<T> {
 191| |    if (kind === target) return value as T;
 192| |    if (kind !== "none") return convert<T>(target);
 194| |    if (pending) {
 195| |      if (pendingKind === target) return pending as Promise<T>;
 197|!|      throw new BodyParseError(
 198| |        `Body parse already in progress as "${pendingKind}".`,
 199| |        409
 200| |      );
 201| |    }
 203| |    assertSize(max);
 205| |    pendingKind = target;
 207| |    pending = parser()
 208| |      .then((v) => {
 209| |        kind = target;
 210| |        value = v;
 211| |        pending = null;
 212| |        pendingKind = null;
 213| |        return v;
 214| |      })
 215| |      .catch((err) => {
 216| |        pending = null;
 217| |        pendingKind = null;
 218|!|        throw err;
 219| |      });
 221| |    return pending as Promise<T>;
 222| |  }
 224|▼|  function assertFileSize(file: File): void {
 225| |    if (limits.maxFileBytes && file.size > limits.maxFileBytes) {
 226|!|      throw new BodyParseError("File too large", 413);
 227| |    }
 228| |  }
 230|▼|  const fn = async (): Promise<unknown> => {
 231| |    if (req.method === "GET" || req.method === "HEAD" || req.method === "OPTIONS") {
 232| |      return undefined;
 233| |    }
 235| |    const ct = (req.headers.get("content-type") || "")
 236| |      .split(";")[0]
 237| |      ?.trim()
 238| |      .toLowerCase();
 240| |    if (!ct) return undefined;
 242| |    if (ct.includes("json")) return fn.json();
 243| |    if (ct.includes("x-www-form-urlencoded")) return fn.form();
 244| |    if (ct.includes("multipart/form-data")) return fn.multipart();
 245| |    if (ct.startsWith("text/")) return fn.text();
 247| |    return fn.arrayBuffer();
 248| |  };
 250| |  const body = fn as unknown as LazyBody;
 252| |  body.json = <T = unknown>() =>
 253| |    use<T>(
 254| |      "json",
 255| |      async () => {
 256| |        try {
 257| |          return await req.json();
 258| |        } catch {
 259|!|          throw new BodyParseError("Invalid JSON body", 400);
 260| |        }
 261| |      },
 262| |      limits.maxJsonBytes
 263| |    );
 265| |  body.text = () =>
 266| |    use<string>(
 267| |      "text",
 268| |      async () => {
 269| |        try {
 270| |          return await req.text();
 271| |        } catch {
 272|!|          throw new BodyParseError("Invalid text body", 400);
 273| |        }
 274| |      },
 275| |      limits.maxTextBytes
 276| |    );
 278| |  body.arrayBuffer = () =>
 279| |    use<ArrayBuffer>(
 280| |      "arrayBuffer",
 281| |      async () => {
 282| |        try {
 283| |          return await req.arrayBuffer();
 284| |        } catch {
 285|!|          throw new BodyParseError("Invalid binary body", 400);
 286| |        }
 287| |      },
 288| |      limits.maxTextBytes
 289| |    );
 291| |  body.blob = () =>
 292| |    use<Blob>(
 293| |      "blob",
 294| |      async () => {
 295| |        try {
 296| |          return await req.blob();
 297| |        } catch {
 298|!|          throw new BodyParseError("Invalid blob body", 400);
 299| |        }
 300| |      },
 301| |      limits.maxTextBytes
 302| |    );
 304| |  body.formData = () =>
 305| |    use<FormData>(
 306| |      "formData",
 307| |      async () => {
 308| |        try {
 309| |          return await req.formData();
 310| |        } catch {
 311|!|          throw new BodyParseError("Invalid form/multipart body", 400);
 312| |        }
 313| |      },
 314| |      limits.maxFormBytes
 315| |    );
 317| |  body.form = async () => {
 318| |    const fd = await body.formData();
 319| |    return formDataToRecord(fd);
 320| |  };
 322| |  body.multipart = async () => {
 323| |    const fd = await body.formData();
 324| |    return formDataToObject(fd);
 325| |  };
 327| |  body.file = async (name?: string) => {
 328| |    const fd = await body.formData();
 330| |    if (name) {
 331| |      const value = fd.get(name);
 332| |      if (value instanceof File) {
 333| |        assertFileSize(value);
 334| |        return value;
 335| |      }
 336| |      return null;
 337| |    }
 339| |    for (const value of fd.values()) {
 340| |      if (value instanceof File) {
 341| |        assertFileSize(value);
 342| |        return value;
 343| |      }
 344| |    }
 346| |    return null;
 347| |  };
 349| |  body.files = async (name?: string) => {
 350| |    const fd = await body.formData();
 351| |    const files: File[] = [];
 353| |    if (name) {
 354| |      for (const value of fd.getAll(name)) {
 355| |        if (value instanceof File) {
 356| |          assertFileSize(value);
 357| |          files.push(value);
 358| |        }
 359| |      }
 360| |      return files;
 361| |    }
 363| |    for (const value of fd.values()) {
 364| |      if (value instanceof File) {
 365| |        assertFileSize(value);
 366| |        files.push(value);
 367| |      }
 368| |    }
 370| |    return files;
 371| |  };
 373| |  body.stream = () => {
 374| |    if (kind !== "none") return null;
 375| |    return req.body;
 376| |  };
 378| |  Object.defineProperty(body, "consumed", {
 379| |    get: () => kind !== "none",
 380| |  });
 382| |  Object.defineProperty(body, "parsed", {
 383| |    get: () => value,
 384| |  });
 386| |  return body;
 387| |}
 389| |// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 390| |// Backward compatibility helpers
 391| |// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 393|▼|export interface BodyParser {
 394| |  readonly contentTypes: readonly string[];
 395| |  parse(req: Request): Promise<unknown>;
 396| |}
 398| |export const jsonParser: BodyParser = {
 399| |  contentTypes: ["application/json"],
 400| |  async parse(req) {
 401| |    return createLazyBody(req).json();
 402| |  },
 403| |};
 405| |export const formUrlEncodedParser: BodyParser = {
 406| |  contentTypes: ["application/x-www-form-urlencoded"],
 407| |  async parse(req) {
 408| |    return createLazyBody(req).form();
 409| |  },
 410| |};
 412| |export const multipartParser: BodyParser = {
 413| |  contentTypes: ["multipart/form-data"],
 414| |  async parse(req) {
 415| |    return createLazyBody(req).multipart();
 416| |  },
 417| |};
 419| |export const defaultParsers: readonly BodyParser[] = [
 420| |  jsonParser,
 421| |  formUrlEncodedParser,
 422| |  multipartParser,
 423| |];
 425|▼|export async function parseBody(
 426| |  req: Request,
 427| |  _parsers: readonly BodyParser[] = defaultParsers
 428| |): Promise<unknown> {
 429| |  return createLazyBody(req)();
 430| |}
 432|▼|export function needsBodyParse(method: string): boolean {
 433| |  return method !== "GET" && method !== "HEAD" && method !== "OPTIONS";
 434| |}

   1| |/**
   2| | * Multi-core server helper.
   3| | *
   4| | * Fixed:
   5| | * - uses node:os availableParallelism()
   6| | */
   8| |import { availableParallelism } from "node:os";
  10|▼|export type ServeOptions = Parameters<typeof Bun.serve>[0];
  12| |export interface ClusterServeOptions extends ServeOptions {
  13| |  workers?: number | "auto";
  14| |}
  16|▼|export function serveCluster(options: ClusterServeOptions) {
  17| |  const requested = options.workers ?? 1;
  19| |  const count =
  20| |    requested === "auto"
  21| |      ? Math.max(1, availableParallelism())
  22| |      : Math.max(1, Number(requested));
  24| |  const serveOptions: ServeOptions = { ...options };
  25| |  delete (serveOptions as any).workers;
  27| |  const servers = Array.from({ length: count }, () =>
  28| |    Bun.serve({
  29| |      ...serveOptions,
  30| |      reusePort: count > 1 ? true : serveOptions.reusePort,
  31| |    })
  32| |  );
  34| |  return {
  35| |    servers,
  36| |    port: servers[0]?.port,
  37| |    stop() {
  38| |      for (const server of servers) {
  39| |        server.stop();
  40| |      }
  41| |    },
  42| |  };
  43| |}

   6|▼|export class HTTPError extends Error {
   7| |  constructor(
   8| |    public readonly status: number,
   9| |    message: string,
  10| |    public readonly code?: string,
  11| |    public readonly details?: Record<string, unknown>
  12| |  ) {
  13| |    super(message);
  14| |    this.name = "HTTPError";
  15| |  }
  17| |  toJSON() {
  18| |    return {
  19| |      error: this.message,
  20| |      status: this.status,
  21| |      code: this.code,
  22| |      ...(this.details ? { details: this.details } : {}),
  23| |    };
  24| |  }
  26| |  toResponse(headers?: Record<string, string>): Response {
  27| |    return Response.json(this.toJSON(), {
  28| |      status: this.status,
  29| |      headers: { "content-type": "application/json", ...headers },
  30| |    });
  31| |  }
  32| |}
  34|▼|export class ValidationError extends HTTPError {

  36| |    message: string,
  37| |    public readonly errors: Record<string, string[]>,

  39| |  ) {

  42| |  }

 110| |  return Response.json(

 112| |    { status: 500 }
 113| |  );

 123| |  "Multiple Choices": 300, "Moved Permanently": 301, Found: 302, "Not Modified": 304,

f:createEntry(
  value: V,

---
   1| |/**
   2| | * Production LRU cache backed by lru-cache.
   3| | *
   4| | * Design:
   5| | * - Strict key constraint
   6| | * - Pure entry factory
   7| | * - No explicit undefined option properties
   8| | * - Single-flight getOrSet
   9| | */
  10| |import { LRUCache as LRU } from "lru-cache";
  12|▼|export interface LRUCacheOptions<K extends {}, V> {
  13| |  max?: number;
  14| |  ttlMs?: number;
  15| |  staleTtlMs?: number;
  16| |  maxBytes?: number;
  17| |  sizeOf?: (value: V, key: K) => number;
  18| |  onEvict?: (key: K, value: V) => void;
  19| |}
  21|▼|interface Entry<V> {
  22| |  value: V;
  23| |  bytes: number;
  24| |  expiresAt: number;
  25| |  staleAt: number;
  26| |}
  28|▼|interface WriteOptions {
  29| |  ttlMs?: number;
  30| |  staleTtlMs?: number;
  31| |  bytes?: number;
  32| |}
  34| |/**
  35| | * Create a cache entry with resolved expiry metadata.
  36| | */
  37|▼|const createEntry = <V>(
  38| |  value: V,
  39| |  bytes: number,
  40| |  ttlMs: number,
  41| |  staleTtlMs: number,
  42| |  now: number,
  43| |): Entry<V> => {
  44| |  const expiresAt = ttlMs > 0 ? now + ttlMs : 0;
  45| |  const staleAt = staleTtlMs > 0 ? now + staleTtlMs : expiresAt;
  47| |  return {
  48| |    value,
  49| |    bytes,
  50| |    expiresAt,
  51| |    staleAt,
  52| |  };
  53| |};
  55|▼|export class LRUCache<K extends {}, V> {
  56| |  private lru: LRU<K, Entry<V>>;
  57| |  private inflight = new Map<K, Promise<V>>();
  59| |  constructor(private readonly opts: LRUCacheOptions<K, V> = {}) {
  60| |    this.lru = new LRU<K, Entry<V>>({
  61| |      max: opts.max ?? 1000,
  62| |      sizeCalculation: (entry) => Math.max(1, entry.bytes),
  63| |      dispose: (entry, key) => {
  64| |        opts.onEvict?.(key, entry.value);
  65| |      },
  66| |      ...(opts.maxBytes !== undefined ? { maxSize: opts.maxBytes } : {}),
  67| |    });
  68| |  }
  70| |  get size(): number {
  71| |    return this.lru.size;
  72| |  }
  74| |  get byteSize(): number {
  75| |    return this.lru.calculatedSize;
  76| |  }
  78| |  private now(): number {
  79| |    return Date.now();
  80| |  }
  82| |  private alive(entry: Entry<V>, now: number): boolean {
  83| |    return entry.expiresAt === 0 || entry.expiresAt > now;
  84| |  }
  86| |  private fresh(entry: Entry<V>, now: number): boolean {
  87| |    return entry.staleAt === 0 || entry.staleAt > now;
  88| |  }
  90| |  get(key: K, options: { allowStale?: boolean } = {}): V | undefined {
  91| |    const entry = this.lru.get(key);
  92| |    if (!entry) return undefined;
  94| |    const now = this.now();
  96| |    if (!this.alive(entry, now)) {
  97| |      this.lru.delete(key);
  98| |      return undefined;
  99| |    }
 101| |    if (!options.allowStale && !this.fresh(entry, now)) {
 102| |      return undefined;
 103| |    }
 105| |    return entry.value;
 106| |  }
 108| |  set(key: K, value: V, options: WriteOptions = {}): this {
 109| |    const ttlMs = options.ttlMs ?? this.opts.ttlMs ?? 0;
 110| |    const staleTtlMs = options.staleTtlMs ?? this.opts.staleTtlMs ?? 0;
 111| |    const bytes = options.bytes ?? this.opts.sizeOf?.(value, key) ?? 0;
 113| |    const maxBytes = this.opts.maxBytes ?? 0;
 114| |    if (maxBytes > 0 && bytes > maxBytes) return this;
 116| |    const entry = createEntry(value, bytes, ttlMs, staleTtlMs, this.now());
 117| |    const lruTtl = Math.max(ttlMs, staleTtlMs);
 119| |    if (lruTtl > 0) {
 120| |      this.lru.set(key, entry, { ttl: lruTtl });
 121| |    } else {
 122| |      this.lru.set(key, entry);
 123| |    }
 125| |    return this;
 126| |  }
 128| |  delete(key: K): boolean {
 129| |    return this.lru.delete(key);
 130| |  }
 132| |  clear(): void {
 133| |    this.lru.clear();
 134| |    this.inflight.clear();
 135| |  }
 137| |  async getOrSet(
 138| |    key: K,
 139| |    factory: () => Promise<V> | V,
 140| |    options: WriteOptions = {},
 141| |  ): Promise<V> {
 142| |    const now = this.now();
 143| |    const entry = this.lru.get(key);
 145| |    if (entry && this.alive(entry, now)) {
 146| |      if (!this.fresh(entry, now) && !this.inflight.has(key)) {
 147| |        const revalidate = Promise.resolve()
 148| |          .then(factory)
 149| |          .then((value) => {
 150| |            this.set(key, value, options);
 151| |            return value;
 152| |          })
 153| |          .catch(() => entry.value)
 154| |          .finally(() => {
 155| |            this.inflight.delete(key);
 156| |          });
 158| |        this.inflight.set(key, revalidate);
 159| |      }
 161| |      return entry.value;
 162| |    }
 164| |    const pending = this.inflight.get(key);
 165| |    if (pending) return pending;
 167| |    const promise = Promise.resolve()
 168| |      .then(factory)
 169| |      .then((value) => {
 170| |        this.set(key, value, options);
 171| |        return value;
 172| |      })
 173| |      .finally(() => {
 174| |        this.inflight.delete(key);
 175| |      });
 177| |    this.inflight.set(key, promise);
 178| |    return promise;
 179| |  }
 180| |}

---
   1| |/**
   2| | * Proxy / forwarding helpers.
   3| | *
   4| | * Design:
   5| | * - Pure header sanitizers
   6| | * - Pure request-init factory
   7| | * - No global BodyInit dependency
   8| | * - AbortSignal.timeout based cancellation
   9| | */
  11| |const HOP_BY_HOP = [
  12| |  "connection",
  13| |  "keep-alive",
  14| |  "proxy-authenticate",
  15| |  "proxy-authorization",
  16| |  "te",
  17| |  "trailer",
  18| |  "transfer-encoding",
  19| |  "upgrade",
  20| |] as const;
  22|▼|type FetchRequestInit = NonNullable<Parameters<typeof fetch>[1]>;
  24|▼|type ProxyRequestInit = FetchRequestInit & {
  25| |  duplex?: "half";
  26| |};
  28| |export interface ProxyOptions extends Omit<FetchRequestInit, "body"> {
  29| |  timeoutMs?: number;
  30| |  body?: FetchRequestInit["body"];
  31| |}
  33| |/**
  34| | * Remove hop-by-hop headers and request-specific headers
  35| | * that must be recomputed for upstream.
  36| | */
  37|▼|const sanitizeRequestHeaders = (headers: Headers): Headers => {
  38| |  const out = new Headers(headers);
  40| |  for (const h of HOP_BY_HOP) out.delete(h);
  42| |  out.delete("host");
  43| |  out.delete("content-length");
  45| |  return out;
  46| |};
  48| |/**
  49| | * Remove hop-by-hop headers from upstream response.
  50| | */
  51|▼|const sanitizeResponseHeaders = (headers: Headers): Headers => {
  52| |  const out = new Headers(headers);
  54| |  for (const h of HOP_BY_HOP) out.delete(h);
  56| |  return out;
  57| |};
  59| |/**
  60| | * Create a combined timeout + optional caller signal.
  61| | */
  62|▼|const createProxySignal = (opts: ProxyOptions): AbortSignal => {
  63| |  const timeoutSignal = AbortSignal.timeout(opts.timeoutMs ?? 10_000);
  65| |  if (!opts.signal) return timeoutSignal;
  67| |  if (typeof AbortSignal.any === "function") {
  68| |    return AbortSignal.any([opts.signal, timeoutSignal]);
  69| |  }
  71| |  return timeoutSignal;
  72| |};
  74| |/**
  75| | * Type guard for stream-like bodies.
  76| | */
  77|▼|const isReadableStream = (
  78| |  value: unknown,
  79| |): value is ReadableStream<Uint8Array> =>
  80| |  typeof value === "object" &&
  81| |  value !== null &&
  82| |  "pipeTo" in value &&
  83| |  typeof value.pipeTo === "function";
  85| |/**
  86| | * Build fetch init for upstream request.
  87| | */
  88|▼|const createProxyInit = (
  89| |  opts: ProxyOptions,
  90| |  signal: AbortSignal,
  91| |): ProxyRequestInit => {
  92| |  const headers = sanitizeRequestHeaders(
  93| |    opts.headers instanceof Headers ? opts.headers : new Headers(opts.headers),
  94| |  );
  96| |  const init: ProxyRequestInit = {
  97| |    method: opts.method ?? "GET",
  98| |    headers,
  99| |    redirect: opts.redirect ?? "manual",
 100| |    signal,
 101| |  };
 103| |  const body = opts.body;
 105| |  if (body != null) {
 106| |    init.body = body;
 108| |    if (isReadableStream(body)) {
 109| |      init.duplex = "half";
 110| |    }
 111| |  }
 113| |  return init;
 114| |};
 116|▼|const isTimeoutError = (err: unknown): boolean =>
 117| |  err instanceof Error &&
 118| |  (err.name === "TimeoutError" || err.name === "AbortError");
 120|▼|const createGatewayTimeout = (): Response =>
 121| |  Response.json({ error: "Upstream timeout", status: 504 }, { status: 504 });
 123|▼|const createBadGateway = (): Response =>
 124| |  Response.json({ error: "Bad Gateway", status: 502 }, { status: 502 });
 126|▼|export async function proxyRequest(
 127| |  target: string | URL,
 128| |  opts: ProxyOptions = {},
 129| |): Promise<Response> {
 130| |  try {
 131| |    const signal = createProxySignal(opts);
 132| |    const init = createProxyInit(opts, signal);
 134| |    const upstream = await fetch(target.toString(), init);
 136| |    const responseHeaders = sanitizeResponseHeaders(upstream.headers);
 137| |    responseHeaders.set("x-proxy", "flux");
 139| |    return new Response(upstream.body, {
 140| |      status: upstream.status,
 141| |      statusText: upstream.statusText,
 142| |      headers: responseHeaders,
 143| |    });
 144|!|  } catch (err) {
 145| |    if (isTimeoutError(err)) {
 146| |      return createGatewayTimeout();
 147| |    }
 149| |    return createBadGateway();
 150| |  }
 151| |}
 153|▼|export async function forwardRequest(
 154| |  req: Request,
 155| |  target: string | URL,
 156| |  opts: ProxyOptions = {},
 157| |): Promise<Response> {
 158| |  const incoming = new URL(req.url);
 159| |  const targetUrl = new URL(target.toString());
 161| |  if (!targetUrl.search) {
 162| |    targetUrl.search = incoming.search;
 163| |  }
 165| |  const headers = sanitizeRequestHeaders(req.headers);
 167| |  const hasBody =
 168| |    req.method !== "GET" && req.method !== "HEAD" && req.body != null;
 170| |  const body = hasBody ? req.body : undefined;
 172| |  return proxyRequest(targetUrl, {
 173| |    ...opts,
 174| |    method: req.method,
 175| |    headers,
 176| |    ...(body ? { body } : {}),
 177| |  });
 178| |}

  18| |  return parseQuery(url.slice(qIdx + 1));

   1| |/**
   2| | * @fileoverview Server-Sent Events (SSE) support.
   3| | * Streaming responses with proper formatting.
   4| | */
   6|▼|export interface SSEOptions {
   7| |  event?: string;
   8| |  id?: string;
   9| |  retry?: number;
  10| |}
  12|▼|export interface SSEMessage {
  13| |  data: string;
  14| |  event?: string;
  15| |  id?: string;
  16| |  retry?: number;
  17| |}
  19|▼|export const formatSSE = (msg: SSEMessage): string => {
  20| |  let out = "";
  21| |  if (msg.id) out += `id: ${msg.id}\n`;
  22| |  if (msg.event) out += `event: ${msg.event}\n`;
  23| |  if (msg.retry) out += `retry: ${msg.retry}\n`;
  24| |  out += `data: ${msg.data}\n\n`;
  25| |  return out;
  26| |};
  28|▼|export const sse = (
  29| |  generator: AsyncGenerator<string | SSEMessage> | Generator<string | SSEMessage>,
  30| |  init?: ResponseInit
  31| |): Response => {
  32| |  const encoder = new TextEncoder();
  34| |  const stream = new ReadableStream({
  35| |    async start(controller) {
  36| |      try {
  37| |        for await (const chunk of generator as AsyncGenerator<string | SSEMessage>) {
  38| |          const msg = typeof chunk === "string" ? { data: chunk } : chunk;
  39| |          controller.enqueue(encoder.encode(formatSSE(msg)));
  40| |        }
  41| |      } catch { /* stream closed */ }
  42| |      finally { controller.close(); }
  43| |    }
  44| |  });
  46| |  return new Response(stream, {
  47| |    ...init,
  48| |    headers: {
  49| |      "content-type": "text/event-stream",
  50| |      "cache-control": "no-cache",
  51| |      "connection": "keep-alive",
  52| |      ...init?.headers,
  53| |    },
  54| |  });
  55| |};
  57|▼|export const sseFromStream = (stream: ReadableStream, init?: ResponseInit): Response =>
  58| |  new Response(stream, {
  59| |    ...init,
  60| |    headers: {
  61| |      "content-type": "text/event-stream",
  62| |      "cache-control": "no-cache",
  63| |      "connection": "keep-alive",
  64| |      ...init?.headers,
  65| |    },
  66| |  });

   1| |/**
   2| | * Distributed tracing helpers.
   3| | *
   4| | * Fixed:
   5| | * - uses crypto.randomUUID()
   6| | * - does not mutate response headers directly
   7| | */
   9|▼|export type TraceEvent =
  10| |  | "request"
  11| |  | "parse"
  12| |  | "transform"
  13| |  | "beforeHandle"
  14| |  | "handle"
  15| |  | "afterHandle"
  16| |  | "mapResponse"
  17| |  | "afterResponse"
  18| |  | "error";
  20|▼|export interface TraceSpan {
  21| |  id: string;
  22| |  name: string;
  23| |  event: TraceEvent;
  24| |  begin: number;
  25| |  end?: number;
  26| |  error?: Error | null;
  27| |  attributes?: Record<string, unknown>;
  28| |  children: TraceSpan[];
  29| |}
  31|▼|export interface TraceContext {
  32| |  traceId: string;
  33| |  spans: TraceSpan[];
  34| |  startSpan(name: string, event: TraceEvent): TraceSpan;
  35| |  endSpan(span: TraceSpan, error?: Error | null): void;
  36| |}
  38| |let traceCounter = 0;
  40|▼|export const createTraceContext = (requestId: string): TraceContext => {
  41| |  const spans: TraceSpan[] = [];
  43| |  return {
  44| |    traceId: requestId,
  45| |    spans,
  46| |    startSpan(name, event) {
  47| |      const span: TraceSpan = {
  48| |        id: `${requestId}-${++traceCounter}`,
  49| |        name,
  50| |        event,
  51| |        begin: performance.now(),
  52| |        children: [],
  53| |      };
  55| |      spans.push(span);
  56| |      return span;
  57| |    },
  58| |    endSpan(span, error = null) {
  59| |      span.end = performance.now();
  60| |      span.error = error;
  61| |    },
  62| |  };
  63| |};
  65| |export const startTrace = (req: Request): { traceId: string; start: number } => {
  66| |  const traceId =
  67| |    req.headers.get("x-trace-id") ||
  68| |    req.headers.get("x-request-id") ||
  69| |    crypto.randomUUID();
  71| |  return { traceId, start: performance.now() };
  72| |};
  74|▼|export const finishTrace = (
  75| |  _req: Request,
  76| |  trace: { traceId: string; start: number },
  77| |  response: Response
  78| |): Response => {
  79| |  const duration = performance.now() - trace.start;
  81| |  const headers = new Headers(response.headers);
  82| |  headers.set("x-trace-id", trace.traceId);
  83| |  headers.set("x-response-time", duration.toFixed(2) + "ms");
  85| |  return new Response(response.body, {
  86| |    status: response.status,
  87| |    statusText: response.statusText,
  88| |    headers,
  89| |  });
  90| |};

   1| |/**

  12|▼|export type HttpMethod = (typeof HTTP_METHODS)[number];
  14|▼|export type MaybePromise<T> = T | Promise<T>;
  15|▼|export type MaybeArray<T> = T | T[];
  16|▼|export type MaybeReadonlyArray<T> = T | readonly T[];
  17|▼|export type Prettify<T> = { [K in keyof T]: T[K] } & {};
  18|▼|export type IsAny<T> = 0 extends 1 & T ? true : false;
  19|▼|export type IsNever<T> = [T] extends [never] ? true : false;

  26| |  readonly "~standard": {
  27| |    readonly version: 1;
  28| |    readonly vendor: string;

  30| |      value: unknown
  31| |    ) => MaybePromise<{ value: Output } | { issues: readonly SchemaIssue[] }>;

   1| |/**
   2| | * Compiler options validation.
   3| | *
   4| | * Removed unimplemented flags:
   5| | * - enableSIMDPaths
   6| | * - enableBranchPrediction
   7| | * - enableDeadCodeElimination
   8| | * - enableConstantFolding
   9| | * - enableWorkerThreads
  10| | * - enableSchemaInlining
  11| | * - enableResponsePreserialization
  12| | * - browserCache
  13| | * - cacheBust
  14| | */
  16| |import { Type, type Static } from "@sinclair/typebox";
  17| |import Ajv from "ajv";
  18| |import type { CompilerOptions } from "./types";
  19| |import { DEFAULT_OPTS } from "./types";
  20| |import type { Result } from "./fp";
  21| |import { ok, err } from "./fp";
  23| |const CompilerOptionsSchema = Type.Object(
  24| |  {
  25| |    routesDir: Type.String({ minLength: 1 }),
  26| |    outDir: Type.String({ minLength: 1 }),
  27| |    outFile: Type.String({ minLength: 1 }),
  29| |    target: Type.Union([
  30| |      Type.Literal("bun"),
  31| |      Type.Literal("node"),
  32| |      Type.Literal("deno"),
  33| |    ]),
  35| |    optimizationLevel: Type.Union([
  36| |      Type.Literal(0),
  37| |      Type.Literal(1),
  38| |      Type.Literal(2),
  39| |      Type.Literal(3),
  40| |    ]),
  42| |    inlineThreshold: Type.Number({ minimum: 0, maximum: 1000 }),
  43| |    enableHandlerDeduplication: Type.Boolean(),
  44| |    sourceMap: Type.Boolean(),
  45| |    minify: Type.Boolean(),
  47| |    hooksDir: Type.Optional(Type.String({ minLength: 1 })),
  49| |    enableTracing: Type.Optional(Type.Boolean()),
  50| |    enableAccessLog: Type.Optional(Type.Boolean()),
  51| |    enableTraceHeaders: Type.Optional(Type.Boolean()),
  52| |    enableLifecycle: Type.Optional(Type.Boolean()),
  53| |    enableStrictMethods: Type.Optional(Type.Boolean()),
  54| |    enableFastBodyParsing: Type.Optional(Type.Boolean()),
  56| |    serviceName: Type.Optional(Type.String({ minLength: 1 })),
  57| |    requestIdHeader: Type.Optional(Type.String({ minLength: 1 })),
  58| |    exposeErrorDetails: Type.Optional(Type.Boolean()),
  60| |    maxJsonBytes: Type.Optional(Type.Integer({ minimum: 0 })),
  61| |    maxTextBytes: Type.Optional(Type.Integer({ minimum: 0 })),
  62| |    maxFormBytes: Type.Optional(Type.Integer({ minimum: 0 })),
  63| |    maxFileBytes: Type.Optional(Type.Integer({ minimum: 0 })),
  65| |    cluster: Type.Optional(
  66| |      Type.Union([Type.Integer({ minimum: 1 }), Type.Literal("auto")])
  67| |    ),
  69| |    reusePort: Type.Optional(Type.Boolean()),
  70| |  },
  71| |  { additionalProperties: false }
  72| |);
  74|▼|export type ValidatedCompilerOptions = Static<typeof CompilerOptionsSchema>;
  76| |const ajv = new Ajv({
  77| |  allErrors: true,
  78| |  strict: false,
  79| |  useDefaults: true,
  80| |  coerceTypes: false,
  81| |});
  83| |const validate = ajv.compile(CompilerOptionsSchema);
  85|▼|export const validateOptions = (
  86| |  input: Partial<CompilerOptions>
  87| |): Result<CompilerOptions, string[]> => {
  88| |  const data = { ...DEFAULT_OPTS, ...input };
  90| |  if (validate(data)) {
  91| |    return ok(data as CompilerOptions);
  92| |  }
  94| |  const errors = (validate.errors ?? []).map((e) => {
  95| |    const path =
  96| |      e.instancePath?.replace(/^\//, "").replace(/\//g, ".") ||
  97| |      (e.params as any)?.missingProperty ||
  98| |      "options";
 100| |    return `${path}: ${e.message}`;
 101| |  });
 103| |  return err(errors);
 104| |};

---
   1| |/**
   2| | * @fileoverview Bun.Transpiler-based AST Parser
   3| | * Replaces regex hacks with a proper ESTree walker.
   4| | * Handles edge cases: nested functions, template literals, comments, re-exports, etc.
   5| | */
   7| |import type {
   8| |  ContextUsage,
   9| |  ImportInfo,
  10| |  ExportInfo,
  11| |  SymbolInfo,
  12| |  Position,
  13| |} from "../types";
  14| |import * as oxcParser from "oxc-parser";
  16| |import { createRequire } from "node:module";
  17| |/**
  18| | * Build ImportInfo without assigning explicit undefined properties.
  19| | *
  20| | * This satisfies exactOptionalPropertyTypes cleanly.
  21| | */
  23|▼|const createImportInfo = (
  24| |  source: string,
  25| |  names: string[],
  26| |  defaultName?: string,
  27| |  namespaceName?: string,
  28| |): ImportInfo => {
  29| |  const info: {
  30| |    source: string;
  31| |    names: string[];
  32| |    defaultName?: string;
  33| |    namespaceName?: string;
  34| |  } = {
  35| |    source,
  36| |    names,
  37| |  };
  39| |  if (defaultName !== undefined) info.defaultName = defaultName;
  40| |  if (namespaceName !== undefined) info.namespaceName = namespaceName;
  42| |  return info;
  43| |};
  46| |// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  47| |// ESTree Walker — tiny, zero-dependency
  48| |// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  50|▼|function walk(node: any, cb: (node: any) => void): void {
  51| |  if (!node || typeof node !== "object") return;
  52| |  cb(node);
  53| |  for (const key of Object.keys(node)) {
  54| |    if (key === "parent" || key === "loc" || key === "range") continue;
  55| |    const child = node[key];
  56| |    if (Array.isArray(child)) {
  57| |      for (const c of child) walk(c, cb);
  58| |    } else if (child && typeof child === "object" && child.type) {
  59| |      walk(child, cb);
  60| |    }
  61| |  }
  62| |}
  64|▼|function walkUntil<T>(node: any, predicate: (node: any) => T | undefined): T | undefined {
  65| |  let result: T | undefined;
  66| |  walk(node, (n) => {
  67| |    if (result !== undefined) return;
  68| |    const r = predicate(n);
  69| |    if (r !== undefined) result = r;
  70| |  });
  71| |  return result;
  72| |}
  74| |// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  75| |// Context-Usage Detection
  76| |// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  78| |const CONTEXT_METHODS = new Set([
  79| |  "json", "text", "html", "redirect", "stream", "empty", "get", "set",
  80| |]);
  82| |const CONTEXT_PROPS = new Set([
  83| |  "body", "params", "query", "file", "files", "headers", "state", "req", "url",
  84| |]);
  86| |/** Build a map: localVariableName → contextProperty (or "__root__") */
  87|▼|function buildContextMapping(params: any[]): Map<string, string> {
  88| |  const map = new Map<string, string>();
  89| |  for (const param of params) {
  90| |    if (!param) continue;
  91| |    if (param.type === "Identifier") {
  92| |      map.set(param.name, "__root__");
  93| |    } else if (param.type === "ObjectPattern") {
  94| |      for (const prop of param.properties || []) {
  95| |        if (prop.type !== "Property") continue;
  96| |        const key = prop.key?.name ?? prop.key?.value;
  97| |        const local = prop.value?.name ?? prop.value?.value;
  98| |        if (key && local) map.set(local, key);
  99| |        // Nested destructuring not supported for DX simplicity
 100| |      }
 101| |    }
 102| |  }
 103| |  return map;
 104| |}
 106|▼|function detectUsage(bodyNode: any, mapping: Map<string, string>): ContextUsage {
 107| |  const usage: ContextUsage = {
 108| |    body: false, params: false, query: false, file: false,
 109| |    headers: false, state: false, json: false, text: false,
 110| |    redirect: false, req: false, url: false,
 111| |  };
 113| |  walk(bodyNode, (n) => {
 114| |    // MemberExpression: ctx.body, ctx.params, etc.
 115| |    if (n.type === "MemberExpression" && !n.computed && n.object?.type === "Identifier") {
 116| |      const root = mapping.get(n.object.name);
 117| |      if (root === "__root__") {
 118| |        const prop = n.property.name;
 119| |        if (prop === "body" || prop === "files") usage.body = true;
 120| |        if (prop === "file") usage.file = true;
 121| |        if (prop === "params") usage.params = true;
 122| |        if (prop === "query") usage.query = true;
 123| |        if (prop === "headers") usage.headers = true;
 124| |        if (prop === "state") usage.state = true;
 125| |        if (prop === "req") usage.req = true;
 126| |        if (prop === "url") usage.url = true;
 127| |        if (CONTEXT_METHODS.has(prop)) {
 128| |          if (prop === "json") usage.json = true;
 129| |          if (prop === "text") usage.text = true;
 130| |          if (prop === "redirect") usage.redirect = true;
 131| |        }
 132| |      }
 133| |    }
 135| |    // Identifier read: destructured `body` from ({ body })
 136| |    if (n.type === "Identifier" && mapping.has(n.name)) {
 137| |      const prop = mapping.get(n.name)!;
 138| |      if (prop === "body" || prop === "files") usage.body = true;
 139| |      if (prop === "file") usage.file = true;
 140| |      if (prop === "params") usage.params = true;
 141| |      if (prop === "query") usage.query = true;
 142| |      if (prop === "headers") usage.headers = true;
 143| |      if (prop === "state") usage.state = true;
 144| |      if (prop === "req") usage.req = true;
 145| |      if (prop === "url") usage.url = true;
 146| |    }
 147| |  });
 149| |  return usage;
 150| |}
 152| |// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 153| |// Handler Extraction
 154| |// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 156| |const HTTP_WRAPPERS = new Set(["get", "post", "put", "patch", "del", "all"]);
 157|▼|const nodeStart = (node: any): number | undefined =>
 158| |  node?.range?.[0] ?? node?.start ?? node?.span?.[0];
 160|▼|const nodeEnd = (node: any): number | undefined =>
 161| |  node?.range?.[1] ?? node?.end ?? node?.span?.[1];
 163|▼|function extractHandlerFunction(node: any): { fn: any; isAsync: boolean } | null {
 164| |  // export default get(async (ctx) => ...)
 165| |  if (node.type === "CallExpression" && node.callee?.type === "Identifier" && HTTP_WRAPPERS.has(node.callee.name)) {
 166| |    const arg = node.arguments?.[0];
 167| |    if (!arg) return null;
 168| |    if (arg.type === "ArrowFunctionExpression" || arg.type === "FunctionExpression") {
 169| |      return { fn: arg, isAsync: arg.async ?? false };
 170| |    }
 171| |    // export default get(myHandler)
 172| |    if (arg.type === "Identifier") {
 173| |      // We can't inline a referenced handler — return null to signal "imported"
 174| |      return null;
 175| |    }
 176| |  }
 177| |  // export default (ctx) => ...
 178| |  if (node.type === "ArrowFunctionExpression" || node.type === "FunctionExpression") {
 179| |    return { fn: node, isAsync: node.async ?? false };
 180| |  }
 181| |  // export default async function(ctx) { ... }
 182| |  if (node.type === "FunctionDeclaration") {
 183| |    return { fn: node, isAsync: node.async ?? false };
 184| |  }
 185| |  return null;
 186| |}
 188|▼|export interface ExtractedHandler {
 189| |  readonly body: string;        // source slice of function body
 190| |  readonly isAsync: boolean;
 191| |  readonly paramName: string;  // first param identifier name (or "ctx" fallback)
 192| |  readonly usage: ContextUsage;
 193| |}
 195|▼|export function extractHandler(source: string, ast: any): ExtractedHandler | null {
 196| |  const defaultExport = walkUntil<any>(ast, (n) =>
 197| |    n.type === "ExportDefaultDeclaration" ? n : undefined
 198| |  );
 200| |  if (!defaultExport) return null;
 202| |  const extracted = extractHandlerFunction(defaultExport.declaration);
 203| |  if (!extracted) return null;
 205| |  const { fn, isAsync } = extracted;
 206| |  const params = fn.params || [];
 207| |  const mapping = buildContextMapping(params);
 208| |  const rootParam = params[0]?.type === "Identifier" ? params[0].name : "ctx";
 210| |  let bodyText = "";
 211| |  const body = fn.body;
 213| |  if (body) {
 214| |    const start = nodeStart(body);
 215| |    const end = nodeEnd(body);
 217| |    if (start != null && end != null) {
 218| |      if (body.type === "BlockStatement") {
 219| |        bodyText = source.slice(start + 1, end - 1).trim();
 220| |      } else {
 221| |        bodyText = `return ${source.slice(start, end).trim()};`;
 222| |      }
 223| |    }
 224| |  }
 226| |  const usage = detectUsage(body || fn, mapping);
 228| |  return {
 229| |    body: bodyText,
 230| |    isAsync,
 231| |    paramName: rootParam,
 232| |    usage,
 233| |  };
 234| |}
 235| |// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 236| |// Import / Export / Symbol Extraction (AST-based, zero regex)
 237| |// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 239|▼|export function extractImportsAST(ast: any): ImportInfo[] {
 240| |  const imports: ImportInfo[] = [];
 242| |  walk(ast, (n) => {
 243| |    if (n.type !== "ImportDeclaration") return;
 245| |    const source = n.source?.value as string;
 246| |    if (!source) return;
 248| |    const names: string[] = [];
 249| |    let defaultName: string | undefined;
 250| |    let namespaceName: string | undefined;
 252| |    for (const spec of n.specifiers || []) {
 253| |      if (spec.type === "ImportDefaultSpecifier") defaultName = spec.local.name;
 254| |      if (spec.type === "ImportNamespaceSpecifier") namespaceName = spec.local.name;
 255| |      if (spec.type === "ImportSpecifier") names.push(spec.local.name);
 256| |    }
 258| |    imports.push(createImportInfo(source, names, defaultName, namespaceName));
 259| |  });
 261| |  return imports;
 262| |}
 264|▼|export function extractExportsAST(ast: any): ExportInfo[] {
 265| |  const exports: ExportInfo[] = [];
 266| |  walk(ast, (n) => {
 267| |    if (n.type === "ExportDefaultDeclaration") {
 268| |      const name = n.declaration?.name || "default";
 269| |      exports.push({ name, kind: "default" });
 270| |    }
 271| |    if (n.type === "ExportNamedDeclaration") {
 272| |      for (const spec of n.specifiers || []) {
 273| |        if (spec.type === "ExportSpecifier") {
 274| |          exports.push({ name: spec.local.name, kind: "named" });
 275| |        }
 276| |      }
 277| |      for (const decl of n.declaration ? [n.declaration] : []) {
 278| |        if (decl.type === "FunctionDeclaration" || decl.type === "VariableDeclaration") {
 279| |          const id = decl.id || decl.declarations?.[0]?.id;
 280| |          if (id?.name) exports.push({ name: id.name, kind: "named" });
 281| |        }
 282| |      }
 283| |    }
 284| |  });
 285| |  return exports;
 286| |}
 288|▼|function posFromNode(source: string, node: any): Position {
 289| |  if (node.loc) return { line: node.loc.start.line, column: node.loc.start.column };
 290| |  return { line: 0, column: 0 };
 291| |}
 293|▼|export function extractSymbolsAST(source: string, ast: any): SymbolInfo[] {
 294| |  const symbols: SymbolInfo[] = [];
 295| |  walk(ast, (n) => {
 296| |    if (n.type === "FunctionDeclaration" && n.id?.name) {
 297| |      symbols.push({
 298| |        name: n.id.name,
 299| |        kind: "function",
 300| |        pos: posFromNode(source, n),
 301| |        isAsync: n.async ?? false,
 302| |        isDefaultExport: false,
 303| |        params: (n.params || []).map((p: any) => p.name || "..."),
 304| |        decorators: [],
 305| |        calls: [],
 306| |        calledBy: [],
 307| |        size: n.range ? n.range[1] - n.range[0] : 9999,
 308| |        hotness: 0,
 309| |      });
 310| |    }
 311| |    if (n.type === "VariableDeclaration") {
 312| |      for (const decl of n.declarations || []) {
 313| |        if (decl.id?.name && decl.init?.type === "ArrowFunctionExpression") {
 314| |          symbols.push({
 315| |            name: decl.id.name,
 316| |            kind: "const",
 317| |            pos: posFromNode(source, n),
 318| |            isAsync: decl.init.async ?? false,
 319| |            isDefaultExport: false,
 320| |            params: (decl.init.params || []).map((p: any) => p.name || "..."),
 321| |            decorators: [],
 322| |            calls: [],
 323| |            calledBy: [],
 324| |            size: n.range ? n.range[1] - n.range[0] : 9999,
 325| |            hotness: 0,
 326| |          });
 327| |        }
 328| |      }
 329| |    }
 330| |  });
 331| |  return symbols;
 332| |}
 334|▼|export function hasDefaultExportAST(ast: any): boolean {
 335| |  return walkUntil(ast, (n) => (n.type === "ExportDefaultDeclaration" ? true : undefined)) ?? false;
 336| |}
 338|▼|export function hasSchemaExportAST(ast: any): boolean {
 339| |  let found = false;
 340| |  walk(ast, (n) => {
 341| |    if (n.type === "ExportNamedDeclaration" && n.declaration?.type === "VariableDeclaration") {
 342| |      for (const d of n.declaration.declarations || []) {
 343| |        if (d.id?.name === "schema") found = true;
 344| |      }
 345| |    }
 346| |    if (n.type === "ExportSpecifier" && n.local?.name === "schema") found = true;
 347| |  });
 348| |  return found;
 349| |}
 351|▼|export function hasConfigExportAST(ast: any): boolean {
 352| |  let found = false;
 353| |  walk(ast, (n) => {
 354| |    if (n.type === "ExportNamedDeclaration" && n.declaration?.type === "VariableDeclaration") {
 355| |      for (const d of n.declaration.declarations || []) {
 356| |        if (d.id?.name === "config") found = true;
 357| |      }
 358| |    }
 359| |    if (n.type === "ExportSpecifier" && n.local?.name === "config") found = true;
 360| |  });
 361| |  return found;
 362| |}
 364| |// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 365| |// Purity Analysis (AST-based)
 366| |// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 368| |const IMPURE_GLOBALS = new Set([
 369| |  "fetch", "Date", "Math", "console", "process", "crypto",
 370| |  "setTimeout", "setInterval", "clearTimeout", "clearInterval",
 371| |  "Promise", "Map", "Set", "WeakMap", "WeakSet",
 372| |]);
 374| |const IMPURE_CALLS = new Set([
 375| |  "Math.random", "Date.now", "crypto.randomUUID", "crypto.getRandomValues",
 376| |  "console.log", "console.warn", "console.error", "fetch",
 377| |]);
 379|▼|export function isPureBodyAST(ast: any): boolean {
 380| |  let impure = false;
 381| |  walk(ast, (n) => {
 382| |    if (impure) return;
 383| |    // new Date(), new Map(), etc.
 384| |    if (n.type === "NewExpression" && n.callee?.type === "Identifier" && IMPURE_GLOBALS.has(n.callee.name)) {
 385| |      impure = true;
 386| |    }
 387| |    // fetch(), Math.random(), etc.
 388| |    if (n.type === "CallExpression") {
 389| |      const callee = n.callee;
 390| |      if (callee.type === "Identifier" && IMPURE_GLOBALS.has(callee.name)) {
 391| |        impure = true;
 392| |      }
 393| |      if (callee.type === "MemberExpression") {
 394| |        const chain = flattenMember(callee);
 395| |        if (chain && IMPURE_CALLS.has(chain)) impure = true;
 396| |      }
 397| |    }
 398| |    // await
 399| |    if (n.type === "AwaitExpression") {
 400| |      // Conservative: any await is impure (could be DB, fetch, etc.)
 401| |      impure = true;
 402| |    }
 403| |  });
 404| |  return !impure;
 405| |}
 407|▼|function flattenMember(node: any): string | null {
 408| |  if (node.type === "Identifier") return node.name;
 409| |  if (node.type === "MemberExpression" && !node.computed) {
 410| |    const obj = flattenMember(node.object);
 411| |    const prop = node.property?.name;
 412| |    if (obj && prop) return `${obj}.${prop}`;
 413| |  }
 414| |  return null;
 415| |}
 417| |// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 418| |// Response-Type Inference (AST-based)
 419| |// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 421|▼|export function inferResponseTypeAST(ast: any): "json" | "text" | "html" | "stream" | "unknown" {
 422| |  let type: "json" | "text" | "html" | "stream" | "unknown" = "unknown";
 423| |  walk(ast, (n) => {
 424| |    if (n.type === "CallExpression" && n.callee?.type === "MemberExpression") {
 425| |      const chain = flattenMember(n.callee);
 426| |      if (chain === "ctx.json") type = "json";
 427| |      if (chain === "ctx.text") type = "text";
 428| |      if (chain === "ctx.html") type = "html";
 429| |      if (chain === "ctx.stream") type = "stream";
 430| |    }
 431| |    // Heuristic: return "string" or template literal → text
 432| |    if (n.type === "ReturnStatement" && n.argument?.type === "Literal" && typeof n.argument.value === "string") {
 433| |      if (type === "unknown") type = "text";
 434| |    }
 435| |  });
 436| |  return type;
 437| |}
 439| |// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 440| |// Main Parse Entry
 441| |// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 443|▼|export interface ParseResult {
 444| |  readonly ast: any;
 445| |  readonly imports: ImportInfo[];
 446| |  readonly exports: ExportInfo[];
 447| |  readonly symbols: SymbolInfo[];
 448| |  readonly hasDefaultExport: boolean;
 449| |  readonly schemaExport: boolean;
 450| |  readonly configExport: boolean;
 451| |  readonly handler: ExtractedHandler | null;
 452| |  readonly config?: any;
 453| |}
 455| |// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 456| |// AST Parser Bridge
 457| |// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 459|▼|function normalizeAst(result: any): any {
 460| |  if (!result) {
 461| |    return { type: "Program", body: [] };
 462| |  }
 464| |  if (result.errors && result.errors.length > 0) {
 465|!|    throw new Error(result.errors[0]?.message ?? "AST parse error");
 466| |  }
 468| |  const ast = result.program ?? result.ast ?? result.root ?? result;
 470| |  if (!ast.type) ast.type = "Program";
 471| |  if (!Array.isArray(ast.body)) ast.body = [];
 473| |  return ast;
 474| |}
 476|▼|function tryOxcParser(source: string): any | undefined {
 477| |  const mod = oxcParser as any;
 478| |  const parseSync = mod.parseSync ?? mod.default?.parseSync;
 480| |  if (typeof parseSync !== "function") return undefined;
 482| |  const attempts = [
 483| |    () =>
 484| |      parseSync("flux.ts", source, {
 485| |        sourceType: "module",
 486| |        target: "esnext",
 487| |      }),
 488| |    () =>
 489| |      parseSync(source, {
 490| |        sourceType: "module",
 491| |        target: "esnext",
 492| |      }),
 493| |  ];
 495| |  for (const attempt of attempts) {
 496| |    try {
 497| |      const result = attempt();
 499| |      if (result && typeof result.then === "function") continue;
 500| |      if (result?.errors?.length) continue;
 502| |      const program = result?.program ?? result?.ast ?? result;
 504| |      if (program?.type || Array.isArray(program?.body)) {
 505| |        return program;
 506| |      }
 507| |    } catch {
 508| |      // try next shape
 509| |    }
 510| |  }
 512| |  return undefined;
 513| |}
 515|▼|function parseToAst(source: string): any {
 516| |  const oxc = tryOxcParser(source);
 517| |  if (oxc) return normalizeAst(oxc);
 519| |  const B: any = Bun;
 521| |  const parsers: Array<() => any> = [
 522| |    () =>
 523| |      typeof B.parse === "function"
 524| |        ? B.parse(source, {
 525| |            loader: "ts",
 526| |            target: "bun",
 527| |            ranges: true,
 528| |            loc: true,
 529| |          })
 530| |        : undefined,
 532| |    () =>
 533| |      typeof B.parseSync === "function"
 534| |        ? B.parseSync(source, {
 535| |            loader: "ts",
 536| |            target: "bun",
 537| |            ranges: true,
 538| |            loc: true,
 539| |          })
 540| |        : undefined,
 542| |    () => {
 543| |      const transpiler = B.Transpiler
 544| |        ? new B.Transpiler({ loader: "ts", target: "bun" })
 545| |        : undefined;
 547| |      return transpiler && typeof transpiler.parse === "function"
 548| |        ? transpiler.parse(source, { ranges: true, loc: true })
 549| |        : undefined;
 550| |    },
 552| |    () => {
 553| |      const transpiler = B.Transpiler
 554| |        ? new B.Transpiler({ loader: "ts", target: "bun" })
 555| |        : undefined;
 557| |      return transpiler && typeof transpiler.parseSync === "function"
 558| |        ? transpiler.parseSync(source, { ranges: true, loc: true })
 559| |        : undefined;
 560| |    },
 561| |  ];
 563| |  for (const parser of parsers) {
 564| |    try {
 565| |      const result = parser();
 567| |      if (result && typeof result.then === "function") continue;
 569| |      if (result) {
 570| |        return normalizeAst(result);
 571| |      }
 572| |    } catch {
 573| |      // try next parser
 574| |    }
 575| |  }
 577|!|  throw new Error(
 578| |    "No synchronous JS/TS AST parser available. Install oxc-parser or use a Bun version with Bun.parse/Bun.parseSync."
 579| |  );
   ... (73 more lines)

   1| |/**
   2| | * @fileoverview Phase 5: LINKER
   3| | * Uses esbuild for safe minification and source maps.
   4| | *
   5| | * Design:
   6| | * - Pure transform-option factories
   7| | * - No explicit undefined properties
   8| | * - Minimal IO boundary
   9| | */
  10| |import { writeFileSync, mkdirSync } from "fs";
  11| |import { join } from "path";
  12| |import { transformSync, type TransformOptions } from "esbuild";
  13| |import type { CompilerOptions } from "../types";
  14| |import type { Logger } from "../logger";
  16| |const BASE_TRANSFORM: TransformOptions = {
  17| |  loader: "js",
  18| |  target: "esnext",
  19| |  format: "esm",
  20| |};
  22| |/**
  23| | * Create esbuild options for standalone minification.
  24| | */
  25|▼|const createMinifyOptions = (): TransformOptions => ({
  26| |  ...BASE_TRANSFORM,
  27| |  minify: true,
  28| |});
  30| |/**
  31| | * Create esbuild options for standalone source map emission.
  32| | */
  33|▼|const createSourceMapOptions = (fileName: string): TransformOptions => ({
  34| |  ...BASE_TRANSFORM,
  35| |  sourcefile: fileName,
  36| |  sourcemap: "external",
  37| |  minify: false,
  38| |});
  40| |/**
  41| | * Create linker transform options only when needed.
  42| | *
  43| | * Returning undefined signals:
  44| | * "no transform required, write original code".
  45| | */
  46|▼|const createLinkOptions = (
  47| |  opts: CompilerOptions,
  48| |): TransformOptions | undefined => {
  49| |  if (!opts.minify && !opts.sourceMap) return undefined;
  51| |  const options: TransformOptions = {
  52| |    ...BASE_TRANSFORM,
  53| |    minify: opts.minify,
  54| |    sourcefile: opts.outFile,
  55| |  };
  57| |  if (opts.sourceMap) {
  58| |    return {
  59| |      ...options,
  60| |      sourcemap: "external",
  61| |    };
  62| |  }
  64| |  return options;
  65| |};
  67| |/**
  68| | * Write final output and optional source map.
  69| | */
  70|▼|const writeLinkedOutput = (
  71| |  outPath: string,
  72| |  code: string,
  73| |  map: string | undefined,
  74| |  opts: CompilerOptions,
  75| |): string => {
  76| |  if (opts.sourceMap && map) {
  77| |    const codeWithMap = `${code}
  78| |//# sourceMappingURL=${opts.outFile}.map`;
  80| |    writeFileSync(outPath, codeWithMap);
  81| |    writeFileSync(`${outPath}.map`, map);
  83| |    return codeWithMap;
  84| |  }
  86| |  writeFileSync(outPath, code);
  87| |  return code;
  88| |};
  90|▼|export const minifyCode = (code: string): string =>
  91| |  transformSync(code, createMinifyOptions()).code;
  93|▼|export const emitSourceMap = (fileName: string, code: string): string =>
  94| |  transformSync(code, createSourceMapOptions(fileName)).map;
  96|▼|export const runLinker = (
  97| |  code: string,
  98| |  opts: CompilerOptions,
  99| |  logger: Logger,
 100| |): string =>
 101| |  logger.time("linker", () => {
 102| |    mkdirSync(opts.outDir, { recursive: true });
 104| |    const outPath = join(opts.outDir, opts.outFile);
 105| |    const transformOptions = createLinkOptions(opts);
 107| |    if (!transformOptions) {
 108| |      writeFileSync(outPath, code);
 110| |      logger.info(
 111| |        `Linked → ${outPath} (${(Buffer.byteLength(code) / 1024).toFixed(1)} KB)`,
 112| |      );
 114| |      return outPath;
 115| |    }
 117| |    const result = transformSync(code, transformOptions);
 118| |    const finalCode = writeLinkedOutput(outPath, result.code, result.map, opts);
 120| |    logger.info(
 121| |      `Linked → ${outPath} (${(Buffer.byteLength(finalCode) / 1024).toFixed(1)} KB)`,
 122| |    );
 124| |    return outPath;
 125| |  });

   1| |/**
   2| | * @fileoverview Phase 4: CODE GENERATION — BUN NATIVE PERFORMANCE MODE
   3| | *
   4| | * Output strategy:
   5| | * - Use Bun.serve({ routes }) native router.
   6| | * - Use method-specific route objects where possible.
   7| | * - Use static Response objects for constant routes where possible.
   8| | * - Avoid context allocation unless required.
   9| | * - Avoid URL/query/body parsing unless required.
  10| | * - Add tracing/lifecycle only when enabled.
  11| | */

  14| |  RouteDef,

  23| |// ============================================================================

  32| |  accessLog: boolean;
  33| |  traceHeaders: boolean;
  34| |  lifecycle: boolean;

  38| |  requestIdHeader: string;

  43| |  const tracing = opts.enableTracing ?? true;
  45| |  return {
  46| |    tracing,
  47| |    accessLog: opts.enableAccessLog ?? tracing,
  48| |    traceHeaders: opts.enableTraceHeaders ?? tracing,
  49| |    lifecycle: opts.enableLifecycle ?? true,
  50| |    strictMethods: opts.enableStrictMethods ?? true,
  51| |    fastBody: opts.enableFastBodyParsing ?? false,

  62|▼|const normalizeImportPath = (p: string): string => {
  63| |  let s = p
  64| |    .replace(/\\/g, "/")
  65| |    .replace(/\.(ts|tsx|js|mjs|jsx)$/, "");
  67| |  if (!s.startsWith(".")) {
