  69| |  }
  71| |  return s;
  72| |};
  74|▼|const hookIdent = (name: string): string =>
  75| |  `hook_${name.replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9_$]/g, "_")}`;
  77|▼|const handlerImportName = (route: RouteDef): string =>
  78| |  `handler_${route.handlerRef}`;
  80|▼|const methodHandlerName = (route: RouteDef): string =>
  81| |  `${route.method}_${route.handlerRef}`;
  83|▼|const finalizeName = (route: RouteDef): string =>
  84| |  `finalize_${route.handlerRef}`;
  86|▼|const pathHandlerName = (path: string): string =>
  87| |  `route_path_${path
  88| |    .replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9]+/g, "_")
  89| |    .replace(/^_+|_+$/g, "") || "root"
  90| |  }`;
  92|▼|const constantBodyVar = (route: RouteDef): string =>
  93| |  `BODY_${route.handlerRef}`;
  95|▼|const constantInitVar = (route: RouteDef): string =>
  96| |  `INIT_${route.handlerRef}`;
  98|▼|const staticResponseVar = (route: RouteDef): string =>
  99| |  `STATIC_${route.handlerRef}`;
 101|▼|const hooksArrayVar = (route: RouteDef): string =>
 102| |  `HOOKS_${route.handlerRef}`;
 106| |// ============================================================================
 107| |// Route Analysis Helpers
 108| |// ============================================================================
 110|▼|const tryNormalizeConstant = (route: RouteDef): string | null => {
 111| |  if (!route.isConstantResponse || !route.constantResponse) return null;
 112| |  if (route.hooks.length > 0) return null;
 114| |  try {
 115| |    JSON.parse(route.constantResponse);
 116| |    return route.constantResponse;
 117| |  } catch {
 118| |    // Continue.
 119| |  }
 121| |  try {
 122| |    const expr = route.constantResponse
 123| |      .replace(/^return\s+/, "")
 124| |      .replace(/;\s*$/, "")
 125| |      .trim();
 127| |    const value = new Function(`"use strict"; return (${expr});`)();
 128| |    return JSON.stringify(value);
 129| |  } catch {
 130| |    return null;
 131| |  }
 132| |};
 134|▼|const needsRequestBody = (route: RouteDef): boolean =>
 135| |  route.usage.body &&
 136| |  route.method !== "GET" &&
 137| |  route.method !== "HEAD" &&
 138| |  route.method !== "OPTIONS";
 140|▼|const needsFileBody = (route: RouteDef): boolean =>
 141| |  route.usage.file && needsRequestBody(route);
 143|▼|const routeReplyFn = (route: RouteDef): string => {
 144| |  if (route.responseType === "text") return "textReply";
 145| |  if (route.responseType === "html") return "htmlReply";
 146| |  if (route.responseType === "stream") return "streamReply";
 147| |  return "jsonReply";
 148| |};
 150|▼|const validHookNames = (
 151| |  route: RouteDef,
 152| |  hooks: ReadonlyMap<string, HookDef>
 153| |): string[] => route.hooks.filter((name) => hooks.has(name));
 155| |// ============================================================================
 156| |// Finalizer Generation
 157| |// ============================================================================
 159|▼|const generateFinalizer = (route: RouteDef): string => {
 160| |  const reply = routeReplyFn(route);
 162| |  return `function ${finalizeName(route)}(result) {
 163| |  if (result instanceof Response) return result;
 164| |  return ${reply}(result);
 165| |}`;
 166| |};
 168| |// ============================================================================
 169| |// Method Handler Generation
 170| |// ============================================================================
 172|▼|const generateMethodHandler = (
 173| |  route: RouteDef,
 174| |  constantJson: string | null,
 175| |  cfg: CodegenConfig,
 176| |  hooks: ReadonlyMap<string, HookDef>
 177| |): string => {
 178| |  const name = methodHandlerName(route);
 180|▼|  const finish = (expr: string): string =>
 181| |    cfg.tracing ? `finishTrace(req, trace, ${expr})` : expr;
 183|▼|  const finishErr = (expr: string): string =>
 184| |    cfg.tracing
 185| |      ? `finishTraceError(req, trace, ${expr})`
 186| |      : `errorResponse(${expr})`;
 188| |  // Constant response handler.
 189| |  if (constantJson !== null) {
 190| |    const traceLine = cfg.tracing ? "const trace = startTrace(req);" : "";
 191| |    const responseExpr = `new Response(${constantBodyVar(route)}, ${constantInitVar(route)})`;
 193| |    return `function ${name}(req) {
 194| |  ${traceLine}
 195| |  return ${cfg.tracing ? finish(responseExpr) : responseExpr};
 196| |}`;
 197| |  }
 199| |  const hookNames = validHookNames(route, hooks);
 200| |  const hasHooks = cfg.lifecycle && hookNames.length > 0;
 202| |  const body = needsRequestBody(route);
 203| |  const file = needsFileBody(route);
 205| |  const isAsync = route.isAsync || body || file || hasHooks;
 207| |  const pre: string[] = [];
 209| |  if (cfg.tracing) {
 210| |    pre.push("const trace = startTrace(req);");
 211| |  }
 213| |  if (route.usage.url || route.usage.query) {
 214| |    pre.push("const url = new URL(req.url);");
 215| |  }
 217| |  if (route.usage.query) {
 218| |    pre.push("const query = url.searchParams;");
 219| |  }
 221| |  const usesBody = needsRequestBody(route) || route.usage.file;
 223| |  if (usesBody) {
 224| |    pre.push("const body = createLazyBody(req, BODY_LIMITS);");
 225| |  }
 227| |  if (route.usage.state) {
 228| |    pre.push("const state = new Map();");
 229| |  }
 231| |  if (hasHooks) {
 232| |    pre.push(
 233| |      `const ctx = createFluxContext(req, req.params ?? EMPTY_PARAMS, ${route.usage.query ? "query" : "undefined"
 234| |      });`
 235| |    );
 237| |    if (body) {
 238| |      pre.push("ctx.body = body;");
 239| |    }
 241| |    pre.push(`const halted = await runHooks(${hooksArrayVar(route)}, ctx);`);
 242| |    pre.push(`if (halted) return ${finish("halted")};`);
 243| |  }
 245|▼|  const minimalCallExpr = (): string => {
 246| |    const props: string[] = [];
 248| |    if (route.usage.params) {
 249| |      props.push("params: req.params ?? EMPTY_PARAMS");
 250| |    }
 252| |    if (route.usage.body && body) {
 253| |      props.push("body");
 254| |    }
 256| |    if (route.usage.query) {
 257| |      props.push("query");
 258| |    }
 260| |    if (route.usage.body || route.usage.file) {
 261| |      props.push("body");
 262| |    }
 264| |    if (route.usage.headers) {
 265| |      props.push("headers: req.headers");
 266| |    }
 268| |    if (route.usage.req) {
 269| |      props.push("req");
 270| |    }
 272| |    if (route.usage.url) {
 273| |      props.push("url");
 274| |    }
 276| |    if (route.usage.state) {
 277| |      props.push("state");
 278| |      props.push("getState: (key) => state.get(key)");
 279| |      props.push("setState: (key, value) => { state.set(key, value); }");
 280| |    }
 282| |    if (route.usage.json) {
 283| |      props.push("json: jsonReply");
 284| |    }
 286| |    if (route.usage.text) {
 287| |      props.push("text: textReply");
 288| |    }
 290| |    if (route.usage.redirect) {
 291| |      props.push("redirect: redirectReply");
 292| |    }
 294| |    if (route.responseType === "html") {
 295| |      props.push("html: htmlReply");
 296| |    }
 298| |    if (route.responseType === "stream") {
 299| |      props.push("stream: streamReply");
 300| |    }
 302| |    if (props.length === 0) {
 303| |      return `${handlerImportName(route)}()`;
 304| |    }
 306| |    return `${handlerImportName(route)}({ ${props.join(", ")} })`;
 307| |  };
 309| |  const callExpr = hasHooks
 310| |    ? `${handlerImportName(route)}(ctx)`
 311| |    : minimalCallExpr();
 313| |  if (isAsync) {
 314| |    pre.push(`const result = await ${callExpr};`);
 315| |    pre.push(`return ${finish(`${finalizeName(route)}(result)`)};`);
 317| |    return `async function ${name}(req) {
 318| |  try {
 319| |    ${pre.join("\n    ")}
 320| |  } catch (err) {
 321| |    return ${finishErr("err")};
 322| |  }
 323| |}`;
 324| |  }
 326| |  // Sync fast path with promise escape hatch.
 327| |  const lines = [...pre];
 329| |  lines.push(`const result = ${callExpr};`);
 330| |  lines.push(`if (result instanceof Response) return ${finish("result")};`);
 331| |  lines.push(
 332| |    `if (result && typeof result.then === "function") {
 333| |      return result
 334| |        .then((v) => ${finish(`${finalizeName(route)}(v)`)})
 335| |        .catch((err) => ${finishErr("err")});
 336| |    }`
 337| |  );
 338| |  lines.push(`return ${finish(`${finalizeName(route)}(result)`)};`);
 340| |  return `function ${name}(req) {
 341| |  try {
 342| |    ${lines.join("\n    ")}
 343| |  } catch (err) {
 344| |    return ${finishErr("err")};
 345| |  }
 346| |}`;
 347| |};
 349| |// ============================================================================
 350| |// Main Server Generation
 351| |// ============================================================================
 353|▼|export const generateServer = (
 354| |  routes: readonly RouteDef[],
 355| |  modules: readonly ModuleInfo[],
 356| |  hooks: ReadonlyMap<string, HookDef>,
 357| |  opts: CompilerOptions
 358| |): string => {
 359| |  const cfg = getConfig(opts);
 360| |  const BODY_LIMITS = JSON.stringify({
 361| |    maxJsonBytes: opts.maxJsonBytes ?? 2 * 1024 * 1024,
 362| |    maxTextBytes: opts.maxTextBytes ?? 2 * 1024 * 1024,
 363| |    maxFormBytes: opts.maxFormBytes ?? 2 * 1024 * 1024,
 364| |    maxFileBytes: opts.maxFileBytes ?? 20 * 1024 * 1024,
 365| |  });
 367| |  const fromDir = dirname(join(process.cwd(), opts.outDir, opts.outFile));
 369|▼|  const toImportPath = (absPath: string): string =>
 370| |    normalizeImportPath(relative(fromDir, absPath));
 372|▼|  const runtimeImport = (projectPath: string): string =>
 373| |    toImportPath(join(process.cwd(), projectPath));
 375| |  // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
 376| |  // Constants / route grouping
 377| |  // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
 379| |  const constantMap = new Map<string, string | null>();
 381| |  for (const route of routes) {
 382| |    constantMap.set(route.handlerRef, tryNormalizeConstant(route));
 383| |  }
 385| |  const groups = new Map<string, RouteDef[]>();
 387| |  for (const route of routes) {
 388| |    const arr = groups.get(route.path) ?? [];
 389| |    arr.push(route);
 390| |    groups.set(route.path, arr);
 391| |  }
 393| |  const staticRouteRefs = new Set<string>();
 395| |  for (const group of groups.values()) {
 396| |    if (!cfg.strictMethods && !cfg.tracing && group.length === 1) {
 397| |      const route = group[0]!;
 399| |      if (
 400| |        (route.method === "GET" || route.method === "ALL") &&
 401| |        constantMap.get(route.handlerRef) !== null
 402| |      ) {
 403| |        staticRouteRefs.add(route.handlerRef);
 404| |      }
 405| |    }
 406| |  }
 408| |  const nonConstantRoutes = routes.filter(
 409| |    (r) => constantMap.get(r.handlerRef) === null
 410| |  );
 412| |  const anyNonConstant = nonConstantRoutes.length > 0;
 414| |  const anyBody = nonConstantRoutes.some(
 415| |    (r) => needsRequestBody(r) && !needsFileBody(r)
 416| |  );
 418| |  const anyFile = nonConstantRoutes.some((r) => needsFileBody(r));
 420| |  const anyHooks =

 422| |    routes.some((r) => validHookNames(r, hooks).length > 0);
 424| |  const anyJson =
 425| |    anyNonConstant ||
 426| |    anyHooks ||

 429| |  const anyText =
 430| |    anyHooks ||
 431| |    nonConstantRoutes.some((r) => r.responseType === "text" || r.usage.text);
 433| |  const anyHtml =
 434| |    anyHooks || nonConstantRoutes.some((r) => r.responseType === "html");
 436| |  const anyStream =
 437| |    anyHooks || nonConstantRoutes.some((r) => r.responseType === "stream");
 439| |  const anyRedirect =
 440| |    anyHooks || nonConstantRoutes.some((r) => r.usage.redirect);
 442| |  // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
 443| |  // Imports
 444| |  // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
 446| |  const handlerImports = nonConstantRoutes
 447| |    .map((route) => {
 448| |      const mod = modules[route.moduleIdx];
 450| |      if (!mod) return "";
 452| |      return `import { default as ${handlerImportName(
 453| |        route
 454| |      )} } from "${toImportPath(mod.path)}";`;
 455| |    })
 456| |    .filter((s) => s.length > 0)
 457| |    .join("\n");
 459| |  const missingStubs = nonConstantRoutes
 460| |    .filter((route) => !modules[route.moduleIdx])
 461| |    .map((route) => {
 462| |      return `function ${handlerImportName(route)}() {
 463| |  throw new Error(${JSON.stringify(`Missing module for ${route.file}`)});
 464| |}`;
 465| |    })
 466| |    .join("\n");
 468| |  const hookImports = anyHooks
 469| |    ? Array.from(hooks.values())
 470| |      .map((h) => {
 471| |        const abs = join(process.cwd(), h.source);
 473| |        return `import { default as ${hookIdent(
 474| |          h.name
 475| |        )} } from "${toImportPath(abs)}";`;
 476| |      })
 477| |      .join("\n")
 478| |    : "";
 480| |  // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
 481| |  // Runtime constants
 482| |  // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
 484| |  const baseConstants = `const HDR_JSON = { "content-type": "application/json; charset=utf-8" };
 485| |const JSON_INIT = { headers: HDR_JSON };
 486| |const BODY_LIMITS = ${BODY_LIMITS};
 487| |const NOT_FOUND_BODY = '{"error":"Not Found"}';
 488| |const NOT_FOUND_INIT = { status: 404, headers: HDR_JSON };
 490| |const METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED_BODY = '{"error":"Method Not Allowed"}';
 491| |const METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED_INIT = { status: 405, headers: HDR_JSON };
 493| |const INTERNAL_ERROR_BODY = '{"error":"Internal Server Error"}';
 494| |const INTERNAL_ERROR_INIT = { status: 500, headers: HDR_JSON };
 496| |const EMPTY_PARAMS = Object.freeze({});
 498| |const SERVICE = ${JSON.stringify(cfg.serviceName)};
 499| |const REQUEST_ID_HEADER = ${JSON.stringify(cfg.requestIdHeader)};
 500| |const ACCESS_LOG = ${cfg.accessLog};
 501| |const TRACE_HEADERS = ${cfg.traceHeaders};
 502| |const EXPOSE_ERRORS = ${cfg.exposeErrorDetails};
 504| |const STATUS_TEXT = {
 505| |  400: "Bad Request",
 506| |  401: "Unauthorized",
 507| |  403: "Forbidden",
 508| |  404: "Not Found",
 509| |  405: "Method Not Allowed",
 510| |  409: "Conflict",
 511| |  422: "Unprocessable Entity",
 512| |  429: "Too Many Requests",
 513| |  500: "Internal Server Error",
 514| |};`;
 516| |  const constantLines: string[] = [];
 518| |  for (const route of routes) {
 519| |    const json = constantMap.get(route.handlerRef);
 521| |    if (json == null) continue;
 523| |    constantLines.push(
 524| |      `const ${constantBodyVar(route)} = ${JSON.stringify(json)};`
 525| |    );

 528| |      `const ${constantInitVar(route)} = { status: 200, headers: HDR_JSON };`
 529| |    );
 531| |    if (staticRouteRefs.has(route.handlerRef)) {
 532| |      constantLines.push(
 533| |        `const ${staticResponseVar(route)} = new Response(${constantBodyVar(
 534| |          route
 535| |        )}, ${constantInitVar(route)});`
 536| |      );
 537| |    }
 538| |  }
 540| |  // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
 541| |  // Runtime helpers
 542| |  // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
 544| |  const helpers: string[] = [];
 546| |  helpers.push(`function notFound() {
 547| |  return new Response(NOT_FOUND_BODY, NOT_FOUND_INIT);
 548| |}`);
 550| |  helpers.push(`function methodNotAllowed() {
 551| |  return new Response(METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED_BODY, METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED_INIT);
 552| |}`);
 554| |  helpers.push(`function errorResponse(err, traceId) {
 555| |  const status = err && typeof err.status === "number" ? err.status : 500;
 557| |  const message =
 558| |    EXPOSE_ERRORS && err instanceof Error
 559| |      ? err.message
 560| |      : STATUS_TEXT[status] || "Error";

 564| |  if (traceId) payload.traceId = traceId;
 566| |  return Response.json(payload, { status });
 567| |}`);
 569| |  if (anyJson || anyHooks) {
 570| |    helpers.push(`function jsonReply(data, init) {
 571| |  if (!init) return Response.json(data, JSON_INIT);
 573| |  const headers = new Headers(HDR_JSON);
 575| |  if (init.headers) {
 576| |    new Headers(init.headers).forEach((value, key) => headers.set(key, value));
 577| |  }
 579| |  return Response.json(data, {
 580| |    status: init.status ?? 200,
 581| |    headers,
 582| |  });
 583| |}`);
 584| |  }

   1| |/**
   2| | * @fileoverview HTTP caching primitives:
   3| | * - Cache-Control builder
   4| | * - ETag generation
   5| | * - mtime-based cache bursting
   6| | * - browser conditional requests
   7| | * - LRU-backed HTTP response cache
   8| | */
  10| |import { LRUCache } from "./lru";
  12|▼|export interface CacheControlOptions {
  13| |  maxAge?: number;
  14| |  sMaxAge?: number;
  15| |  swr?: number; // stale-while-revalidate seconds
  16| |  immutable?: boolean;
  17| |  noStore?: boolean;
  18| |  noCache?: boolean;
  19| |  public?: boolean;
  20| |  private?: boolean;
  21| |}
  23| |export interface BrowserCacheOptions extends CacheControlOptions {
  24| |  req?: Request;
  25| |  etag?: string;
  26| |  lastModified?: Date | string;
  27| |  vary?: string[];
  28| |}
  30|▼|export function cacheControl(opts: CacheControlOptions = {}): string {
  31| |  if (opts.noStore) return "no-store";
  32| |  if (opts.noCache) return "no-cache";
  34| |  const parts: string[] = [];
  36| |  if (opts.public) parts.push("public");
  37| |  if (opts.private) parts.push("private");
  39| |  if (opts.maxAge != null) {
  40| |    parts.push(`max-age=${Math.max(0, Math.floor(opts.maxAge))}`);
  41| |  }
  43| |  if (opts.swr != null) {
  44| |    parts.push(`stale-while-revalidate=${Math.max(0, Math.floor(opts.swr))}`);
  45| |  }
  47| |  if (opts.sMaxAge != null) {
  48| |    parts.push(`s-maxage=${Math.max(0, Math.floor(opts.sMaxAge))}`);
  49| |  }
  51| |  if (opts.immutable) parts.push("immutable");
  53| |  return parts.length > 0 ? parts.join(", ") : "no-cache";
  54| |}
  56|▼|function toBytes(input: string | ArrayBuffer | Uint8Array): Uint8Array {
  57| |  if (typeof input === "string") return new TextEncoder().encode(input);
  58| |  if (input instanceof Uint8Array) return input;
  59| |  return new Uint8Array(input);
  60| |}
  62|▼|function fallbackHash(bytes: Uint8Array): bigint {
  63| |  let h = 0xcbf29ce484222325n;
  65| |  for (const b of bytes) {
  66| |    h ^= BigInt(b);
  67| |    h = (h * 0x100000001b3n) & 0xffffffffffffffffn;
  68| |  }
  70| |  return h;
  71| |}
  73| |/**
  74| | * Fast non-cryptographic hash for cache keys and weak ETags.
  75| | * Uses Bun.hash when available.
  76| | */
  77|▼|export function fastHash(input: string | ArrayBuffer | Uint8Array): string {
  78| |  const bytes = toBytes(input);
  80| |  const bunHash = (Bun as any).hash;
  81| |  if (typeof bunHash === "function") {
  82| |    const h = bunHash(bytes);
  83| |    return (typeof h === "bigint" ? h : BigInt(h)).toString(36);
  84| |  }
  86| |  return fallbackHash(bytes).toString(36);
  87| |}
  89|▼|export function entityTag(
  90| |  body: string | ArrayBuffer | Uint8Array,
  91| |  weak = true
  92| |): string {
  93| |  return `${weak ? "W/" : ""}"${fastHash(body)}"`;
  94| |}
  96| |/**
  97| | * mtime-based cache burst version.
  98| | *
  99| | * Example:
 100| | *   mtimeVersion(stats.mtimeMs, stats.size)
 101| | *   => "m4k2j1-1a2b"
 102| | */
 103|▼|export function mtimeVersion(mtimeMs: number, size?: number): string {
 104| |  const mtime = Math.floor(mtimeMs).toString(36);
 105| |  return size ? `${mtime}-${size.toString(36)}` : mtime;
 106| |}
 108| |/**
 109| | * Append a cache-busting version to a URL.
 110| | */
 111|▼|export function withCacheBurst(url: string, version: string): string {
 112| |  const sep = url.includes("?") ? "&" : "?";
 113| |  return `${url}${sep}v=${encodeURIComponent(version)}`;
 114| |}
 116| |/**
 117| | * Apply browser cache headers and handle conditional requests.
 118| | */
 119|▼|export function withBrowserCache(
 120| |  response: Response,
 121| |  opts: BrowserCacheOptions = {}
 122| |): Response {
 123| |  const headers = new Headers(response.headers);
 125| |  if (opts.etag) headers.set("etag", opts.etag);
 127| |  const lastModified =
 128| |    opts.lastModified instanceof Date
 129| |      ? opts.lastModified.toUTCString()
 130| |      : opts.lastModified;
 132| |  if (lastModified) headers.set("last-modified", lastModified);
 134| |  if (!headers.has("cache-control")) {
 135| |    headers.set("cache-control", cacheControl(opts));
 136| |  }
 138| |  if (opts.vary?.length) {
 139| |    headers.set("vary", opts.vary.join(", "));
 140| |  }
 142| |  if (opts.req && response.status !== 304) {
 143| |    const inm = opts.req.headers.get("if-none-match");
 144| |    const ims = opts.req.headers.get("if-modified-since");
 146| |    const etagMatch =
 147| |      opts.etag && inm
 148| |        ? inm
 149| |            .split(",")
 150| |            .map((s) => s.trim())
 151| |            .includes(opts.etag)
 152| |        : false;
 154| |    const lastModifiedMatch =
 155| |      lastModified && ims
 156| |        ? new Date(ims).getTime() >= new Date(lastModified).getTime()
 157| |        : false;
 159| |    if (etagMatch || lastModifiedMatch) {
 160| |      return new Response(null, { status: 304, headers });
 161| |    }
 162| |  }
 164| |  return new Response(response.body, {
 165| |    status: response.status,
 166| |    statusText: response.statusText,
 167| |    headers,
 168| |  });
 169| |}
 171| |// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 172| |// HTTP response cache
 173| |// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 175|▼|export interface HttpResponseCacheOptions {
 176| |  max?: number;
 177| |  ttlMs?: number;
 178| |  staleTtlMs?: number;
 179| |  maxBytes?: number;
 180| |  maxBodyBytes?: number;
 181| |}
 183|▼|export interface CachedHttpResponse {
 184| |  status: number;
 185| |  statusText: string;
 186| |  headers: [string, string][];
 187| |  body: ArrayBuffer | null;
 188| |  etag?: string;
 189| |}
 191| |const HOP_HEADERS = new Set([
 192| |  "connection",
 193| |  "keep-alive",
 194| |  "proxy-authenticate",
 195| |  "proxy-authorization",
 196| |  "te",
 197| |  "trailer",
 198| |  "transfer-encoding",
 199| |  "upgrade",
 200| |  "content-length",
 201| |]);
 203|▼|function sanitizeHeaders(headers: Headers): [string, string][] {
 204| |  const out: [string, string][] = [];
 206| |  headers.forEach((value, key) => {
 207| |    const lower = key.toLowerCase();
 208| |    if (!HOP_HEADERS.has(lower)) {
 209| |      out.push([key, value]);
 210| |    }
 211| |  });
 213| |  return out;
 214| |}
 216|▼|function isCacheableResponse(response: Response): boolean {
 217| |  if (response.headers.has("set-cookie")) return false;
 219| |  const cc = response.headers.get("cache-control") || "";
 220| |  if (cc.includes("no-store")) return false;
 221| |  if (cc.includes("private")) return false;
 223| |  return [200, 203, 204, 300, 301, 404, 410].includes(response.status);
 224| |}
 226|▼|export class HttpResponseCache {
 227| |  private lru: LRUCache<string, CachedHttpResponse>;
 228| |  private maxBodyBytes: number;
 230| |  constructor(opts: HttpResponseCacheOptions = {}) {
 231| |    this.maxBodyBytes = opts.maxBodyBytes ?? 1_048_576;
 233| |    this.lru = new LRUCache({
 234| |      max: opts.max ?? 1000,
 235| |      ttlMs: opts.ttlMs ?? 60_000,
 236| |      staleTtlMs: opts.staleTtlMs ?? 300_000,
 237| |      maxBytes: opts.maxBytes ?? 64 * 1024 * 1024,
 238| |      sizeOf: (v) => (v.body?.byteLength ?? 0) + 512,
 239| |    });
 240| |  }
 242| |  key(req: Request, vary: string[] = []): string {
 243| |    const url = new URL(req.url);
 245| |    const varyKey = vary
 246| |      .map((h) => `${h.toLowerCase()}=${req.headers.get(h) ?? ""}`)
 247| |      .join("|");
 249| |    return `${req.method}:${url.pathname}${url.search}:${varyKey}`;
 250| |  }
 252| |  async get(req: Request, key: string): Promise<Response | null> {
 253| |    const stored = this.lru.get(key, { allowStale: true });
 254| |    if (!stored) return null;
 256| |    const inm = req.headers.get("if-none-match");
 258| |    if (
 259| |      stored.etag &&
 260| |      inm &&
 261| |      inm
 262| |        .split(",")
 263| |        .map((s) => s.trim())
 264| |        .includes(stored.etag)
 265| |    ) {
 266| |      return new Response(null, {
 267| |        status: 304,
 268| |        headers: stored.headers,
 269| |      });
 270| |    }
 272| |    const headers = new Headers(stored.headers);
 273| |    headers.set("x-cache", "hit");
 275| |    return new Response(stored.body ? stored.body.slice(0) : null, {
 276| |      status: stored.status,
 277| |      statusText: stored.statusText,
 278| |      headers,
 279| |    });
 280| |  }
 282| |  async set(
 283| |    key: string,
 284| |    response: Response,
 285| |    opts: { ttlMs?: number; staleTtlMs?: number; etag?: boolean } = {},
 286| |  ): Promise<Response> {
 287| |    if (!isCacheableResponse(response)) return response;
 289| |    const clone = response.clone();
 290| |    const body = await clone.arrayBuffer();
 292| |    if (body.byteLength > this.maxBodyBytes) {
 293| |      return response;
 294| |    }
 296| |    const headers = sanitizeHeaders(response.headers);
 297| |    const etag = opts.etag === false ? undefined : entityTag(body);
 299| |    if (etag) {
 300| |      headers.push(["etag", etag]);
 301| |    }
 303| |    const cached: CachedHttpResponse = {
 304| |      status: response.status,
 305| |      statusText: response.statusText,
 306| |      headers,
 307| |      body,
 308| |    };
 310| |    if (etag) {
 311| |      cached.etag = etag;
 312| |    }
 314| |    this.lru.set(key, cached, {
 315| |      ...(opts.ttlMs !== undefined ? { ttlMs: opts.ttlMs } : {}),
 316| |      ...(opts.staleTtlMs !== undefined ? { staleTtlMs: opts.staleTtlMs } : {}),
 317| |    });
 319| |    return response;
 320| |  }
 322| |  async getOrSet(
 323| |    req: Request,
 324| |    factory: () => Promise<Response>,
 325| |    opts: {
 326| |      ttlMs?: number;
 327| |      staleTtlMs?: number;
 328| |      vary?: string[];
 329| |      etag?: boolean;
 330| |    } = {}
 331| |  ): Promise<Response> {
 332| |    if (req.method !== "GET" && req.method !== "HEAD") {
 333| |      return factory();
 334| |    }
 336| |    const reqCc = req.headers.get("cache-control") || "";
 337| |    if (reqCc.includes("no-store")) {
 338| |      return factory();
 339| |    }
 341| |    const key = this.key(req, opts.vary);
 342| |    const hit = await this.get(req, key);
 344| |    if (hit) return hit;
 346| |    const response = await factory();
 347| |    return this.set(key, response, opts);
 348| |  }
 349| |}

   6| |import type { RouteSchema, DocumentDecoration, HttpMethod } from "./types";
   8|▼|export interface OpenAPIInfo {
   9| |    title: string;
  10| |    version: string;
  11| |    description?: string;
  12| |}
  14|▼|export interface RouteDefinition {
  15| |    method: HttpMethod;
  16| |    path: string;
  17| |    schema?: RouteSchema;
  18| |    detail?: DocumentDecoration;
  19| |}
  21|▼|export const generateOpenAPI = (
  22| |    info: OpenAPIInfo,
  23| |    routes: RouteDefinition[]
  24| |): Record<string, unknown> => {
  25| |    const paths: Record<string, Record<string, unknown>> = {};
  27| |    for (const route of routes) {
  28| |        if (route.method === "ALL" || route.method === "WS") continue;
  30| |        const openApiPath = route.path
  31| |            .replace(/:(\w+)/g, "{$1}")
  32| |            .replace(/\*(\w+)/g, "{$1}");
  34| |        if (!paths[openApiPath]) paths[openApiPath] = {};
  36| |        const operation: Record<string, unknown> = {
  37| |            operationId: `${route.method.toLowerCase()}_${openApiPath.replace(/[{}\/]/g, "_")}`,
  38| |            ...route.detail,
  39| |            responses: { "200": { description: "Successful response" } },
  40| |        };
  42| |        if (route.schema?.params) {
  43| |            const schema = route.schema.params as any;
  44| |            const required = new Set(schema.required ?? []);
  46| |            operation.parameters = Object.entries(schema.properties ?? {}).map(
  47| |                ([name, propSchema]: [string, any]) => ({
  48| |                    name,
  49| |                    in: "path",
  50| |                    required: required.has(name),
  51| |                    schema: {
  52| |                        type: propSchema.type ?? "string",
  53| |                        ...(propSchema.format ? { format: propSchema.format } : {}),
  54| |                        ...(propSchema.enum ? { enum: propSchema.enum } : {}),
  55| |                    },
  56| |                })
  57| |            );
  58| |        }
  60| |        if (route.schema?.query) {
  61| |            const schema = route.schema.query as any;
  62| |            const required = new Set(schema.required ?? []);
  64| |            const queryParams = Object.entries(schema.properties ?? {}).map(
  65| |                ([name, propSchema]: [string, any]) => ({
  66| |                    name,
  67| |                    in: "query",
  68| |                    required: required.has(name),
  69| |                    schema: {
  70| |                        type: propSchema.type ?? "string",
  71| |                        ...(propSchema.format ? { format: propSchema.format } : {}),
  72| |                        ...(propSchema.enum ? { enum: propSchema.enum } : {}),
  73| |                        ...(propSchema.default !== undefined
  74| |                            ? { default: propSchema.default }
  75| |                            : {}),
  76| |                    },
  77| |                })
  78| |            );
  80| |            operation.parameters = [
  81| |                ...((operation.parameters as any[]) ?? []),
  82| |                ...queryParams,
  83| |            ];
  85| |        }
  87| |        if (route.schema?.body) {
  88| |            operation.requestBody = {
  89| |                content: { "application/json": { schema: route.schema.body } },
  90| |            };
  91| |        }
  93| |        paths[openApiPath][route.method.toLowerCase()] = operation;
  94| |    }
  96| |    return {
  97| |        openapi: "3.1.0",
  98| |        info,
  99| |        paths,
 100| |    };
 101| |};

---
   1| |/**
   2| | * Runtime schema validation.
   3| | *
   4| | * Supports:
   5| | * - TypeBox / JSON Schema via Ajv
   6| | * - Standard Schema v1 via async validation
   7| | */
   9| |import Ajv, { type ErrorObject } from "ajv";
  10| |import addFormats from "ajv-formats";
  11| |import type { AnySchema, StandardSchemaV1 } from "./types";
  12| |import { ValidationError } from "./errors";
  14| |const ajv = new Ajv({
  15| |  allErrors: true,
  16| |  strict: false,
  17| |  coerceTypes: true,
  18| |  removeAdditional: true,
  19| |  useDefaults: true,
  20| |});
  22| |addFormats(ajv);
  24|▼|function isStandardSchema(schema: AnySchema): schema is StandardSchemaV1 {
  25| |  return typeof schema === "object" && schema !== null && "~standard" in schema;
  26| |}
  28|▼|function toErrorRecord(
  29| |  errors: ErrorObject[] | null | undefined,
  30| |  on: string
  31| |): Record<string, string[]> {
  32| |  const out: Record<string, string[]> = {};
  34| |  for (const e of errors ?? []) {
  35| |    const path =
  36| |      e.instancePath?.replace(/^\//, "").replace(/\//g, ".") ||
  37| |      (e.params as any)?.missingProperty ||
  38| |      on;
  40| |    out[path] ??= [];
  41| |    out[path].push(e.message ?? "Invalid value");
  42| |  }
  44| |  return out;
  45| |}
  47|▼|export function compileValidator<T = unknown>(
  48| |  schema: AnySchema,
  49| |  on: string = "input"
  50| |) {
  51| |  if (isStandardSchema(schema)) {
  52| |    return (_input: unknown): T => {
  53|!|      throw new Error(
  54| |        "Standard Schema validators are async. Use validateAsync() instead of compileValidator()."
  55| |      );
  56| |    };
  57| |  }
  59| |  const validate = ajv.compile(schema as object);
  61| |  return (input: unknown): T => {
  62| |    if (!validate(input)) {
  63|!|      throw new ValidationError(
  64| |        "Validation failed",
  65| |        toErrorRecord(validate.errors, on),
  66| |        on
  67| |      );
  68| |    }
  70| |    return input as T;
  71| |  };
  72| |}
  74|▼|export function validateOrThrow<T = unknown>(
  75| |  schema: AnySchema,
  76| |  input: unknown,
  77| |  on: string = "input"
  78| |): T {
  79| |  return compileValidator<T>(schema, on)(input);
  80| |}
  82|▼|export async function validateAsync<T = unknown>(
  83| |  schema: AnySchema,
  84| |  input: unknown,
  85| |  on: string = "input"
  86| |): Promise<T> {
  87| |  if (isStandardSchema(schema)) {
  88| |    const result = await schema["~standard"].validate(input);
  90| |    if ("issues" in result) {
  91| |      const errors: Record<string, string[]> = {};
  93| |      for (const issue of result.issues) {
  94| |        const path = issue.path?.join(".") || on;
  95| |        errors[path] ??= [];
  96| |        errors[path].push(issue.message);
  97| |      }
  99|!|      throw new ValidationError("Validation failed", errors, on);
 100| |    }
 102| |    return result.value as T;
 103| |  }
 105| |  return compileValidator<T>(schema, on)(input);
 106| |}

---
   1| |/**
   2| | * @fileoverview Phase 1: DISCOVERY
   3| | * Scans filesystem for route files and extracts module metadata via AST.
   4| | * IO isolated in entry function. Pure functions do parsing.
   5| | * Now with functional composition and error recovery.
   6| | */
   8| |import { readdirSync, statSync, readFileSync } from "fs";
   9| |import { join, dirname, basename, extname } from "path";
  11| |import type {
  12| |  ModuleInfo,
  13| |  RouteDef,
  14| |  HttpMethod,
  15| |  CompilerOptions,
  16| |  DiscoveryResult,
  17| |} from "../types";
  19| |import { HTTP_METHODS } from "../types";
  20| |import { parseModule as parseModuleAST } from "../utils/ast";
  21| |import type { Logger } from "../logger";
  22| |import { tryCatch } from "../fp";
  24| |// Pure Functions
  25|▼|export const isRouteFile = (entry: string): boolean =>
  26| |  /\.(ts|js|mjs|tsx|jsx)$/.test(entry) && !entry.endsWith(".d.ts");
  28|▼|export const isValidDir = (entry: string): boolean =>
  29| |  !entry.startsWith(".") && entry !== "node_modules";
  31| |/** Safely read directory, returning empty array on error. */
  32|▼|const safeReaddir = (dir: string): string[] => {
  33| |  const result = tryCatch(() => readdirSync(dir));
  34| |  return result.ok ? result.value : [];
  35| |};
  37| |/** Safely check if path is directory. */
  38|▼|const safeIsDir = (path: string): boolean => {
  39| |  const result = tryCatch(() => statSync(path).isDirectory());
  40| |  return result.ok ? result.value : false;
  41| |};
  43| |/** Safely read file, returning empty string on error. */
  44|▼|const safeReadFile = (path: string): string => {
  45| |  const result = tryCatch(() => readFileSync(path, "utf-8"));
  46| |  return result.ok ? result.value : "";
  47| |};
  48|▼|export const scanDirectory = (dir: string, base = ""): string[] => {
  49| |  const out: string[] = [];
  50| |  for (const entry of safeReaddir(dir)) {
  51| |    const abs = join(dir, entry);
  52| |    const rel = join(base, entry).replace(/\\/g, "/");
  53| |    if (safeIsDir(abs)) {
  54| |      if (isValidDir(entry)) {
  55| |        out.push(...scanDirectory(abs, rel));
  56| |      }
  57| |    } else if (isRouteFile(entry)) {
  58| |      out.push(rel);
  59| |    }
  60| |  }
  61| |  return out;
  62| |};
  64|▼|export const parseRouteFilename = (
  65| |  file: string
  66| |): Pick<RouteDef, "method" | "path" | "paramNames" | "isDynamic" | "isStatic" | "segmentCount"> | null => {
  67| |  const ext = extname(file);
  68| |  const name = basename(file, ext);
  69| |  const parts = name.split(".");
  71| |  let method: HttpMethod = "GET";
  72| |  let routeName = name;
  74| |  const lastPart = parts.at(-1);
  75| |  if (lastPart && HTTP_METHODS.includes(lastPart.toUpperCase() as HttpMethod)) {
  76| |    method = lastPart.toUpperCase() as HttpMethod;
  77| |    routeName = parts.slice(0, -1).join(".");
  78| |  }
  80| |  const dirPart = dirname(file);
  81| |  let routePath = "/" + join(dirPart, routeName).replace(/\\/g, "/");
  82| |  if (routePath.endsWith("/index")) {
  83| |    routePath = routePath.slice(0, -5) || "/";
  84| |  }
  86| |  const paramNames: string[] = [];
  87| |  let isDynamic = false;
  89| |  routePath = routePath.replace(/\[(\.\.\.[^\]]+)\]/g, (_, raw: string) => {
  90| |    isDynamic = true;
  91| |    const pname = raw.slice(3);
  92| |    paramNames.push(pname);
  93| |    return "*" + pname;
  94| |  });
  96| |  routePath = routePath.replace(/\[([^\]]+)\]/g, (_, pname: string) => {
  97| |    isDynamic = true;
  98| |    paramNames.push(pname);
  99| |    return ":" + pname;
 100| |  });
 102| |  return {
 103| |    method,
 104| |    path: routePath,
 105| |    paramNames,
 106| |    isDynamic,
 107| |    isStatic: !isDynamic,
 108| |    segmentCount: routePath.split("/").filter(Boolean).length,
 109| |  };
 110| |};
 112|▼|export const parseModule = (
 113| |  filePath: string,
 114| |  relPath: string,
 115| |  content: string,
 116| |): ModuleInfo => {
 117| |  const parsed = parseModuleAST(content);
 119| |  return {
 120| |    path: filePath,
 121| |    relPath,
 122| |    content,
 123| |    imports: parsed.imports,
 124| |    exports: parsed.exports,
 125| |    symbols: parsed.symbols,
 126| |    hasDefaultExport: parsed.hasDefaultExport,
 127| |    callGraph: new Map(),
 128| |    dataFlow: new Map(),
 130| |    ...(parsed.schemaExport ? { schemaExport: "schema" } : {}),
 131| |    ...(parsed.configExport ? { configExport: "config" } : {}),
 132| |  };
 133| |};
 135| |// Phase Orchestrator — Functional composition
 136|▼|export const runDiscovery = (opts: CompilerOptions, logger: Logger): DiscoveryResult =>
 137| |  logger.time("discovery", () => {
 138| |    const files = scanDirectory(opts.routesDir);
 139| |    const modules = files.map(f => {
 140| |      const abs = join(opts.routesDir, f);
 141| |      const content = safeReadFile(abs);
 142| |      return parseModule(abs, f, content);
 143| |    }).filter(m => m.content.length > 0); // Skip unreadable files
 145| |    logger.info(`Discovered ${files.length} files, ${modules.length} modules`, {
 146| |      routesDir: opts.routesDir,
 147| |    });
 148| |    return { files, modules };
 149| |  });

---
   1| |/**
   2| | * Phase 3: OPTIMIZATION
   3| | *
   4| | * Production cleanup:
   5| | * - removed jump table generation
   6| | * - removed dense/sparse/perfect-hash tables
   7| | * - removed response preserialization buffers
   8| | * - removed Zod-specific schema compilation
   9| | * - kept inline detection and deduplication
  10| | */
  12| |import type {
  13| |  RouteDef,
  14| |  ModuleInfo,
  15| |  CompilerOptions,
  16| |  OptimizationResult,
  17| |} from "../types";
  19| |import { estimateNodeCount } from "../utils/ast";
  20| |import type { Logger } from "../logger";
  22|▼|export const isInlineEligible = (
  23| |  route: RouteDef,
  24| |  mod: ModuleInfo | undefined,
  25| |  threshold: number
  26| |): boolean => {
  27| |  if (!mod) return false;
  28| |  if (route.hasValidation) return false;
  29| |  if (route.hooks.length > 0) return false;
  31| |  const nodeCount = estimateNodeCount(mod.content);
  32| |  return nodeCount <= threshold;
  33| |};
  35|▼|export const markInline = (
  36| |  route: RouteDef,
  37| |  modules: readonly ModuleInfo[],
  38| |  threshold: number
  39| |): RouteDef => {
  40| |  const mod = modules[route.moduleIdx];
  41| |  const shouldInline = isInlineEligible(route, mod, threshold);
  43| |  return shouldInline === route.shouldInline ? route : { ...route, shouldInline };
  44| |};
  46|▼|export const detectInlineCandidates = (
  47| |  routes: readonly RouteDef[],
  48| |  modules: readonly ModuleInfo[],
  49| |  threshold: number
  50| |): RouteDef[] => routes.map((r) => markInline(r, modules, threshold));
  52|▼|export const hasConstantResponse = (route: RouteDef): boolean =>
  53| |  route.isConstantResponse && !!route.constantResponse;
  55|▼|export const groupByConstantResponse = (
  56| |  routes: readonly RouteDef[]
  57| |): Map<string, RouteDef[]> => {
  58| |  const groups = new Map<string, RouteDef[]>();
  60| |  for (const route of routes) {
  61| |    if (!hasConstantResponse(route)) continue;
  63| |    const key = route.constantResponse!;
  64| |    const existing = groups.get(key);
  66| |    if (existing) existing.push(route);
  67| |    else groups.set(key, [route]);
  68| |  }
  70| |  return groups;
  71| |};
  73|▼|export const buildDedupMap = (
  74| |  groups: Map<string, RouteDef[]>
  75| |): Map<string, string> => {
  76| |  const replacements = new Map<string, string>();
  78| |  for (const group of groups.values()) {
  79| |    if (group.length < 2) continue;
  81| |    const leader = group[0]!;
  83| |    for (let i = 1; i < group.length; i++) {
  84| |      replacements.set(group[i]!.handlerRef, leader.handlerRef);
  85| |    }
  86| |  }
  88| |  return replacements;
  89| |};
  91|▼|export const applyDedup = (
  92| |  route: RouteDef,
  93| |  dedupMap: Map<string, string>
  94| |): RouteDef => {
  95| |  const dedupGroup = dedupMap.get(route.handlerRef);
  96| |  return dedupGroup ? { ...route, dedupGroup } : route;
  97| |};
  99|▼|export const deduplicateRoutes = (routes: RouteDef[]): RouteDef[] => {
 100| |  const groups = groupByConstantResponse(routes);
 101| |  const dedupMap = buildDedupMap(groups);
 103| |  if (dedupMap.size === 0) return routes;
 105| |  return routes.map((r) => applyDedup(r, dedupMap));
 106| |};
 108|▼|export const countInlined = (routes: readonly RouteDef[]): number =>
 109| |  routes.filter((r) => r.shouldInline).length;
 111|▼|export const countDeduped = (routes: readonly RouteDef[]): number =>
 112| |  routes.filter((r) => r.dedupGroup).length;
 114|▼|export const runOptimization = (
 115| |  routes: readonly RouteDef[],
 116| |  modules: readonly ModuleInfo[],
 117| |  opts: CompilerOptions,
 118| |  logger: Logger
 119| |): OptimizationResult =>
 120| |  logger.time("optimization", () => {
 121| |    const inlined = detectInlineCandidates(routes, modules, opts.inlineThreshold);
 123| |    const deduped = opts.enableHandlerDeduplication
 124| |      ? deduplicateRoutes(inlined)
 125| |      : inlined;
 127| |    const inlinedCount = countInlined(deduped);
 128| |    const dedupedCount = countDeduped(deduped);
 130| |    logger.info(
 131| |      `Optimized: ${inlinedCount} inlined | ${dedupedCount} deduplicated`
 132| |    );
 134| |    return {
 135| |      routes: deduped,
 136| |      meta: {
 137| |        inlined: inlinedCount,
 138| |        deduplicated: dedupedCount,
 139| |        eliminated: routes.length - deduped.length,
 140| |      },
 141| |    };
 142| |  });
---

   1| |/**
   2| | * @fileoverview File response helpers:
   3| | * - static file serving
   4| | * - downloads
   5| | * - HTTP range requests
   6| | * - conditional requests
   7| | * - mtime/ETag browser caching
   8| | */
  10| |import { stat } from "fs/promises";
  11| |import { basename, resolve, normalize, sep } from "path";
  12| |import { NotFoundError, ForbiddenError } from "./errors";
  13| |import { cacheControl } from "./cache";
  15|▼|export interface SendFileOptions {
  16| |  req?: Request;
  17| |  download?: boolean | string;
  18| |  contentType?: string;
  19| |  maxAge?: number;
  20| |  swr?: number;
  21| |  immutable?: boolean;
  22| |  isPrivate?: boolean;
  23| |}
  25|▼|export interface StreamDownloadOptions {
  26| |  filename?: string;
  27| |  contentType?: string;
  28| |  cacheControl?: string;
  29| |  size?: number;
  30| |}
  32| |/**
  33| | * Prevent path traversal.
  34| | *
  35| | * Example:
  36| | *   safeJoin("public", ctx.params.path)
  37| | */
  38|▼|export function safeJoin(root: string, target: string): string {
  39| |  const resolvedRoot = resolve(root);
  40| |  const resolved = resolve(resolvedRoot, normalize(target));
  42| |  if (!resolved.startsWith(resolvedRoot + sep)) {
  43|!|    throw new ForbiddenError("Invalid file path");
  44| |  }
  46| |  return resolved;
  47| |}
  49|▼|function isNotModified(
  50| |  req: Request,
  51| |  etag: string,
  52| |  lastModified: string
  53| |): boolean {
  54| |  const inm = req.headers.get("if-none-match");
  56| |  if (
  57| |    inm &&
  58| |    inm
  59| |      .split(",")
  60| |      .map((s) => s.trim())
  61| |      .includes(etag)
  62| |  ) {
  63| |    return true;
  64| |  }
  66| |  const ims = req.headers.get("if-modified-since");
  68| |  if (ims && new Date(ims).getTime() >= new Date(lastModified).getTime()) {
  69| |    return true;
  70| |  }
  72| |  return false;
  73| |}
  75|▼|export async function sendFile(
  76| |  path: string,
  77| |  opts: SendFileOptions = {}
  78| |): Promise<Response> {
  79| |  const stats = await stat(path).catch(() => null);
  81| |  if (!stats || !stats.isFile()) {
  82|!|    throw new NotFoundError("File");
  83| |  }
  85| |  const file = Bun.file(path);
  87| |  const etag = `W/"${stats.size.toString(16)}-${Math.floor(
  88| |    stats.mtimeMs
  89| |  ).toString(16)}"`;
  91| |  const lastModified = stats.mtime.toUTCString();
  93| |  const headers = new Headers();
  95| |  headers.set(
  96| |    "content-type",
  97| |    opts.contentType || file.type || "application/octet-stream"
  98| |  );
 100| |  headers.set(
 101| |    "cache-control",
 102| |    cacheControl({
 103| |      public: !opts.isPrivate,
 104| |      private: opts.isPrivate,
 105| |      maxAge: opts.maxAge ?? 3600,
 106| |      swr: opts.swr,
 107| |      immutable: opts.immutable,
 108| |    })
 109| |  );
 111| |  headers.set("etag", etag);
 112| |  headers.set("last-modified", lastModified);
 113| |  headers.set("accept-ranges", "bytes");
 115| |  if (opts.download) {
 116| |    const filename =
 117| |      typeof opts.download === "string"
 118| |        ? opts.download
 119| |        : basename(path);
 121| |    headers.set(
 122| |      "content-disposition",
 123| |      `attachment; filename="${filename.replace(/"/g, "")}"`
 124| |    );
 125| |  }
 127| |  if (opts.req && isNotModified(opts.req, etag, lastModified)) {
 128| |    return new Response(null, {
 129| |      status: 304,
 130| |      headers,
 131| |    });
 132| |  }
 134| |  const range = opts.req?.headers.get("range");
 136| |  if (range) {
 137| |    const match = /bytes=(\d*)-(\d*)/.exec(range);
 139| |    if (!match) {
 140| |      return new Response("Range Not Satisfiable", {
 141| |        status: 416,
 142| |        headers: {
 143| |          "content-range": `bytes */${stats.size}`,
 144| |        },
 145| |      });
 146| |    }
 148| |    let start: number;
 149| |    let end: number;
 151| |    if (match[1] === "" && match[2] !== "") {
 152| |      // Suffix range: bytes=-500
 153| |      const suffix = parseInt(match[2]!, 10);
 154| |      start = Math.max(0, stats.size - suffix);
 155| |      end = stats.size - 1;
 156| |    } else {
 157| |      start = match[1] ? parseInt(match[1], 10) : 0;
 158| |      end = match[2] ? parseInt(match[2], 10) : stats.size - 1;
 159| |    }
 161| |    if (
 162| |      Number.isNaN(start) ||
 163| |      Number.isNaN(end) ||
 164| |      start > end ||
 165| |      start >= stats.size
 166| |    ) {
 167| |      return new Response("Range Not Satisfiable", {
 168| |        status: 416,
 169| |        headers: {
 170| |          "content-range": `bytes */${stats.size}`,
 171| |        },
 172| |      });
 173| |    }
 175| |    end = Math.min(end, stats.size - 1);
 177| |    headers.set("content-range", `bytes ${start}-${end}/${stats.size}`);
 178| |    headers.set("content-length", String(end - start + 1));
 180| |    return new Response(file.slice(start, end + 1), {
 181| |      status: 206,
 182| |      headers,
 183| |    });
 184| |  }
 186| |  headers.set("content-length", String(stats.size));
 188| |  return new Response(file, {
 189| |    status: 200,
 190| |    headers,
 191| |  });
 192| |}
 194|▼|export function streamDownload(
 195| |  stream: ReadableStream,
 196| |  opts: StreamDownloadOptions = {}
 197| |): Response {
 198| |  const headers = new Headers({
 199| |    "content-type": opts.contentType || "application/octet-stream",
 200| |    "cache-control": opts.cacheControl || "no-store",
 201| |  });
 203| |  if (opts.filename) {
 204| |    headers.set(
 205| |      "content-disposition",
 206| |      `attachment; filename="${opts.filename.replace(/"/g, "")}"`
 207| |    );
 208| |  }
 210| |  if (opts.size != null) {
 211| |    headers.set("content-length", String(opts.size));
 212| |  }
 214| |  return new Response(stream, {
 215| |    status: 200,
 216| |    headers,
 217| |  });
 218| |}

   1| |/**
   2| | * @fileoverview Phase 2: ANALYSIS — AST-based, zero regex.
   3| | * Detects ctx usage at build time. Produces RouteDefs from discovered modules.
   4| | */
   6| |import type {
   7| |  RouteDef,
   8| |  ModuleInfo,
   9| |  CompilerOptions,
  10| |  HttpMethod,
  11| |  DiscoveryResult,
  12| |  AnalysisResult,
  13| |  HookDef,
  14| |  ContextUsage,
  15| |  RouteCacheConfig,
  16| |} from "../types";
  18| |import { HTTP_METHODS, FULL_CONTEXT_USAGE } from "../types";
  19| |import { parseRouteFilename } from "./discovery";
  20| |import { computeSignatureHash } from "../utils/hash";
  21| |import {
  22| |  parseModule,
  23| |  isPureBodyAST,
  24| |  inferResponseTypeAST,
  25| |} from "../utils/ast";
  26| |import type { Logger } from "../logger";
  28| |// ============================================================================
  29| |// Pure Route Analysis Functions
  30| |// ============================================================================
  32|▼|export const parseRouteFile = (file: string) => parseRouteFilename(file);
  34|▼|export const findModuleByPath = (
  35| |  modules: readonly ModuleInfo[], relPath: string
  36| |): ModuleInfo | undefined => modules.find((m) => m.relPath === relPath);
  38|▼|export const findModuleIndex = (
  39| |  modules: readonly ModuleInfo[], relPath: string
  40| |): number => modules.findIndex((m) => m.relPath === relPath);
  42| |// ============================================================================
  43| |// Constant Response Detection
  44| |// ============================================================================
  46|▼|const evaluateConstantBody = (body: string): string | null => {
  47| |  const expr = body
  48| |    .replace(/^return\s+/, "")
  49| |    .replace(/;\s*$/, "")
  50| |    .trim();
  52| |  if (!expr) return null;
  54| |  try {
  55| |    // Only called after isPureBodyAST() has approved the body.
  56| |    const fn = new Function(`"use strict"; return (${expr});`);
  57| |    const value = fn();
  58| |    return JSON.stringify(value);
  59| |  } catch {
  60| |    return null;
  61| |  }
  62| |};
  64| |export const detectConstantResponse = (
  65| |  mod: ModuleInfo
  66| |): { isConstant: boolean; constantResponse?: string } => {
  67| |  const parsed = parseModule(mod.content);
  69| |  if (!parsed.handler) {
  70| |    return { isConstant: false };
  71| |  }
  73| |  if (!isPureBodyAST(parsed.ast)) {
  74| |    return { isConstant: false };
  75| |  }
  77| |  const json = evaluateConstantBody(parsed.handler.body);
  79| |  if (!json) {
  80| |    return { isConstant: false };
  81| |  }
  83| |  return {
  84| |    isConstant: true,
  85| |    constantResponse: json,
  86| |  };
  87| |};
  89| |// ============================================================================
  90| |// RouteDef Factory — Pure
  91| |// ============================================================================
  93|▼|export const buildHandlerRef = (routeIndex: number): string => `_h${routeIndex}`;
  94|▼|export const buildSchemaRef = (routeIndex: number, hasSchema: boolean): string | null =>
  95| |  hasSchema ? `_s${routeIndex}` : null;
  96|▼|export const computeMethodIndex = (method: HttpMethod): number =>
  97| |  HTTP_METHODS.indexOf(method);
  99|▼|export const findHandlerSymbol = (mod: ModuleInfo) =>
 100| |  mod.symbols.find((s) => s.name === "default") || mod.symbols[0];
 101| |/**
 102| | * Normalize exported route cache config.
 103| | *
 104| | * Pure and exactOptionalPropertyTypes-safe.
 105| | */
 106|▼|const normalizeRouteCache = (
 107| |  input: unknown,
 108| |): RouteCacheConfig | undefined => {
 109| |  if (typeof input === "number") {
 110| |    return { maxAge: input };
 111| |  }
 113| |  if (!input || typeof input !== "object") {
 114| |    return undefined;
 115| |  }
 117| |  const cfg = input as Record<string, unknown>;
 119| |  const cache: {
 120| |    maxAge?: number;
 121| |    swr?: number;
 122| |    immutable?: boolean;
 123| |    vary?: string[];
 124| |  } = {};
 126| |  if (typeof cfg.maxAge === "number") cache.maxAge = cfg.maxAge;
 127| |  if (typeof cfg.swr === "number") cache.swr = cfg.swr;
 128| |  if (typeof cfg.immutable === "boolean") cache.immutable = cfg.immutable;
 130| |  if (Array.isArray(cfg.vary)) {
 131| |    cache.vary = cfg.vary.filter(
 132| |      (item): item is string => typeof item === "string",
 133| |    );
 134| |  }
 136| |  return Object.keys(cache).length > 0 ? cache : undefined;
 137| |};
 140|▼|export const createRouteDef = (
 141| |  file: string,
 142| |  parsed: NonNullable<ReturnType<typeof parseRouteFilename>>,
 143| |  mod: ModuleInfo,
 144| |  routeIndex: number,
 145| |  moduleIdx: number,
 146| |): RouteDef => {
 147| |  const handlerSym = findHandlerSymbol(mod);
 148| |  const methodIdx = computeMethodIndex(parsed.method);
 150| |  const astParsed = parseModule(mod.content);
 152| |  const cache = normalizeRouteCache(astParsed.config?.cache);
 153| |  const usage = astParsed.handler?.usage ?? FULL_CONTEXT_USAGE;
 155| |  const isAsync =
 156| |    astParsed.handler?.isAsync ?? handlerSym?.isAsync ?? false;
 158| |  const hooks = Array.isArray(astParsed.config?.hooks)
 159| |    ? astParsed.config.hooks.filter(
 160| |        (x: unknown): x is string => typeof x === "string",
 161| |      )
 162| |    : [];
 164| |  const { isConstant, constantResponse } = detectConstantResponse(mod);
 165| |  const inferredResponseType = inferResponseTypeAST(astParsed.ast);
 167| |  const responseType = usage.json
 168| |    ? "json"
 169| |    : usage.text
 170| |      ? "text"
 171| |      : inferredResponseType;
 173| |  return {
 174| |    ...parsed,
 175| |    file,
 176| |    moduleIdx,
 177| |    handlerRef: buildHandlerRef(routeIndex),
 178| |    schemaRef: buildSchemaRef(routeIndex, !!mod.schemaExport),
 179| |    signatureHash: computeSignatureHash(methodIdx, parsed.path),
 180| |    handlerSize: handlerSym?.size || 9999,
 181| |    isAsync,
 182| |    shouldInline: false,
 183| |    responseType,
 184| |    hasValidation: !!mod.schemaExport,
 185| |    hotnessScore: 0,
 186| |    hooks,
 187| |    isConstantResponse: isConstant,
 188| |    usage,
 190| |    ...(constantResponse !== undefined ? { constantResponse } : {}),
 191| |    ...(cache !== undefined ? { cache } : {}),
 192| |  };
 193| |};
 195| |export const resolveRouteModule = (
 196| |  file: string,
 197| |  modules: readonly ModuleInfo[]
 198| |): { mod: ModuleInfo; parsed: NonNullable<ReturnType<typeof parseRouteFilename>> } | null => {
 199| |  const parsed = parseRouteFile(file);
 200| |  if (!parsed) return null;
 201| |  const mod = findModuleByPath(modules, file);
 202| |  if (!mod) return null;
 203| |  if (!mod.hasDefaultExport) return null;
 204| |  return { mod, parsed };
 205| |};
 207| |// ============================================================================
 208| |// Route Graph Builder — Pure
 209| |// ============================================================================
 211|▼|export const buildRouteGraph = (
 212| |  files: readonly string[],
 213| |  modules: readonly ModuleInfo[]
 214| |): RouteDef[] => {
 215| |  const routes: RouteDef[] = [];
 217| |  for (const file of files) {
 218| |    const resolved = resolveRouteModule(file, modules);
 219| |    if (!resolved) continue;
 221| |    const moduleIdx = findModuleIndex(modules, file);
 222| |    if (moduleIdx < 0) continue;
 224| |    routes.push(
 225| |      createRouteDef(
 226| |        file,
 227| |        resolved.parsed,
 228| |        resolved.mod,
 229| |        routes.length,
 230| |        moduleIdx
 231| |      )
 232| |    );
 233| |  }
 235| |  return routes;
 236| |};
 237| |// ============================================================================
 238| |// Dead Route Detection — Pure
 239| |// ============================================================================
 241|▼|export const staticRouteKey = (route: RouteDef): string =>
 242| |  `${route.method}:${route.path}`;
 244| |export const detectDeadRoutes = (
 245| |  routes: readonly RouteDef[],
 246| |  modules: readonly ModuleInfo[]
 247| |): { alive: RouteDef[]; dead: RouteDef[] } => {
 248| |  const seen = new Map<string, number>();
 249| |  const alive: RouteDef[] = [];
 250| |  const dead: RouteDef[] = [];
 252| |  for (const route of routes) {
 253| |    const hasValidModule = route.moduleIdx >= 0 && route.moduleIdx < modules.length;
 254| |    if (!hasValidModule) {
 255| |      dead.push(route);
 256| |      continue;
 257| |    }
 258| |    if (route.isStatic && seen.has(staticRouteKey(route))) {
 259| |      dead.push(route);
 260| |      continue;
 261| |    }
 262| |    if (route.isStatic) {
 263| |      seen.set(staticRouteKey(route), alive.length);
 264| |    }
 265| |    alive.push(route);
 266| |  }
 267| |  return { alive, dead };
 268| |};
 270| |// ============================================================================
 271| |// Hook Resolution — Pure
 272| |// ============================================================================
 274|▼|export const collectHookNames = (routes: readonly RouteDef[]): Set<string> => {
 275| |  const referenced = new Set<string>();
 276| |  for (const route of routes) {
 277| |    for (const hook of route.hooks) referenced.add(hook);
 278| |  }
 279| |  return referenced;
 280| |};
 282|▼|export const createHookDef = (name: string, hooksDir: string): HookDef => ({
 283| |  name,
 284| |  source: `${hooksDir}/${name}.ts`,
 285| |  moduleIdx: -1,
 286| |  isAsync: true,
 287| |});
 289|▼|export const resolveHooks = (
 290| |  routes: readonly RouteDef[],
 291| |  hooksDir: string | undefined
 292| |): ReadonlyMap<string, HookDef> => {
 293| |  const names = collectHookNames(routes);
 294| |  const hooks = new Map<string, HookDef>();
 295| |  if (!hooksDir || names.size === 0) return hooks;
 296| |  for (const name of names) {
 297| |    hooks.set(name, createHookDef(name, hooksDir));
 298| |  }
 299| |  return hooks;
 300| |};
 302| |// ============================================================================
 303| |// Statistics — Pure
 304| |// ============================================================================
 306|▼|export const countRoutes = (
 307| |  routes: readonly RouteDef[],
 308| |  predicate: (r: RouteDef) => boolean
 309| |): number => routes.filter(predicate).length;
 311|▼|export const countStatic = (routes: readonly RouteDef[]): number =>
 312| |  countRoutes(routes, (r) => r.isStatic);
 313|▼|export const countDynamic = (routes: readonly RouteDef[]): number =>
 314| |  countRoutes(routes, (r) => r.isDynamic);
 315|▼|export const countConstant = (routes: readonly RouteDef[]): number =>
 316| |  countRoutes(routes, (r) => r.isConstantResponse);
 318| |// ============================================================================
 319| |// Phase Orchestrator — Composed from pure functions
 320| |// ============================================================================
 322|▼|export const runAnalysis = (
 323| |  discovery: DiscoveryResult,
 324| |  opts: CompilerOptions,
 325| |  logger: Logger
 326| |): AnalysisResult =>
 327| |  logger.time("analysis", () => {
 328| |    const routes = buildRouteGraph(discovery.files, discovery.modules);
 329| |    const { alive, dead } = detectDeadRoutes(routes, discovery.modules);
 331| |    if (dead.length > 0) {
 332| |      logger.warn(`Eliminated ${dead.length} dead route(s)`, {
 333| |        dead: dead.map((r) => `${r.method} ${r.path}`),
 334| |      });
 335| |    }
 337| |    const hooks = resolveHooks(alive, opts.hooksDir);
 339| |    const needsBody = alive.filter((r) => r.usage.body).length;
 340| |    const needsFile = alive.filter((r) => r.usage.file).length;
 341| |    const needsQuery = alive.filter((r) => r.usage.query).length;
 343| |    logger.info(
 344| |      `Routes: ${alive.length} total (${countStatic(alive)} static, ${countDynamic(alive)} dynamic, ${countConstant(alive)} constant)`
 345| |    );
 346| |    logger.info(
 347| |      `Usage analysis: ${needsBody} need body | ${needsFile} need files | ${needsQuery} need query`
 348| |    );
 350| |    if (hooks.size > 0) {
 351| |      logger.info(`Hooks resolved: ${[...hooks.keys()].join(", ")}`);
 352| |    }
 354| |    return { routes: alive, modules: discovery.modules, hooks };
 355| |  });

   2| | * @fileoverview Flux Context v3.0 — Production-grade request context.

   4| | */
   5| |import * as setCookie from "set-cookie-parser";

  77| |/**
  78| | * Convert a cookie value into a string representation.
  79| | */
  80|▼|const toCookieValue = (value: unknown): string =>
  81| |  typeof value === "object" && value !== null
  82| |    ? JSON.stringify(value)
  83| |    : String(value ?? "");
  85| |/**
  86| | * Encode cookie value safely.
  87| | */
  88|▼|const encodeCookieValue = (value: string): string => encodeURIComponent(value);
  90| |/**
  91| | * Decode cookie value with fallback for malformed values.
  92| | */
  93|▼|const decodeCookieValue = (value: string): string => {
  94| |  try {
  95| |    return decodeURIComponent(value);
  96| |  } catch {
  97| |    return value;
  98| |  }
  99| |};
 101| |/**
 102| | * Normalize SameSite attribute.
 103| | */
 104|▼|const normalizeSameSite = (
 105| |  sameSite: CookieOptions["sameSite"],
 106| |): string | undefined => {
 107| |  if (sameSite === true) return "Strict";
 108| |  if (sameSite === false || sameSite === undefined) return undefined;
 110| |  return sameSite.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + sameSite.slice(1);
 111| |};
 113| |/**
 114| | * Serialize one cookie pair.
 115| | */
 116|▼|const serializeCookiePair = (
 117| |  name: string,
 118| |  value: string,
 119| |  opts: ElysiaCookie,
 120| |): string => {
 121| |  const parts = [`${name}=${encodeCookieValue(value)}`];
 123| |  if (opts.domain) parts.push(`Domain=${opts.domain}`);
 124| |  if (opts.path) parts.push(`Path=${opts.path}`);
 126| |  if (opts.expires instanceof Date) {
 127| |    parts.push(`Expires=${opts.expires.toUTCString()}`);
 128| |  }
 130| |  if (opts.maxAge != null) {
 131| |    parts.push(`Max-Age=${Math.floor(opts.maxAge)}`);
 132| |  }
 134| |  if (opts.httpOnly) parts.push("HttpOnly");
 135| |  if (opts.secure) parts.push("Secure");
 137| |  const sameSite = normalizeSameSite(opts.sameSite);
 138| |  if (sameSite) parts.push(`SameSite=${sameSite}`);
 140| |  if (opts.priority) parts.push(`Priority=${opts.priority}`);
 141| |  if (opts.partitioned) parts.push("Partitioned");
 143| |  return parts.join("; ");
 144| |};
 146|▼|export const serializeCookie = (
 147| |  cookies: Record<string, ElysiaCookie>,
 148| |): string | string[] | undefined => {
 149| |  const serialized = Object.entries(cookies)
 150| |    .filter(([, opts]) => opts?.value != null)
 151| |    .map(([name, opts]) =>
 152| |      serializeCookiePair(name, toCookieValue(opts.value), opts),
 153| |    );
 155| |  if (serialized.length === 0) return undefined;
 157| |  return serialized.length === 1 ? serialized[0] : serialized;
 158| |};
 160|▼|export const parseCookieString = (
 161| |  cookieString: string | null,
 162| |): Record<string, string> => {
 163| |  if (!cookieString) return {};
 165| |  return cookieString
 166| |    .split(";")
 167| |    .reduce<Record<string, string>>((acc, segment) => {
 168| |      const eq = segment.indexOf("=");
 169| |      if (eq === -1) return acc;
 171| |      const key = segment.slice(0, eq).trim();
 172| |      if (!key) return acc;
 174| |      const value = segment.slice(eq + 1).trim();
 175| |      acc[key] = decodeCookieValue(value);
 177| |      return acc;
 178| |    }, {});
 179| |};
 181|▼|export const parseSetCookieHeader = (
 182| |  header: string | string[] | null,
 183| |) => {
 184| |  if (!header) return [];
 185| |  return setCookie.parse(header);
 186| |};
 188| |// ============================================================================
 189| |// Cookie Class
 190| |// ============================================================================
 192|▼|export class Cookie<T = string | undefined> {
 193| |  constructor(
 194| |    private name: string,
 195| |    private jar: Record<string, ElysiaCookie>,
 196| |    private initial: Partial<ElysiaCookie> = {}
 197| |  ) { }
 199| |  get value(): T { return (this.jar[this.name]?.value ?? this.initial.value) as T; }
 200| |  set value(v: T) {
 201| |    const entry = (this.jar[this.name] ??= { ...this.initial });
 202| |    entry.value = v;
 203| |  }
 205| |  get expires() { return this.jar[this.name]?.expires ?? this.initial.expires; }
 206| |  set expires(v: Date | undefined) { this._set("expires", v); }
 208| |  get maxAge() { return this.jar[this.name]?.maxAge ?? this.initial.maxAge; }
 209| |  set maxAge(v: number | undefined) { this._set("maxAge", v); }
 211| |  get domain() { return this.jar[this.name]?.domain ?? this.initial.domain; }
 212| |  set domain(v: string | undefined) { this._set("domain", v); }
 214| |  get path() { return this.jar[this.name]?.path ?? this.initial.path; }
 215| |  set path(v: string | undefined) { this._set("path", v); }
 217| |  get secure() { return this.jar[this.name]?.secure ?? this.initial.secure; }
 218| |  set secure(v: boolean | undefined) { this._set("secure", v); }
 220| |  get httpOnly() { return this.jar[this.name]?.httpOnly ?? this.initial.httpOnly; }
 221| |  set httpOnly(v: boolean | undefined) { this._set("httpOnly", v); }
 223| |  get sameSite() { return this.jar[this.name]?.sameSite ?? this.initial.sameSite; }
 224| |  set sameSite(v: true | false | "lax" | "strict" | "none" | undefined) { this._set("sameSite", v); }
 226| |  update(config: Partial<ElysiaCookie>): this {
 227| |    const entry = (this.jar[this.name] ??= { ...this.initial });
 228| |    Object.assign(entry, config);
 229| |    return this;
 230| |  }
 232| |  remove(): this {
 233| |    this.update({ expires: new Date(0), maxAge: 0, value: "" });
 234| |    return this;
 235| |  }
 237| |  toString(): string {
 238| |    const v = this.value;
 239| |    return typeof v === "object" ? JSON.stringify(v) : String(v ?? "");
 240| |  }
 242| |  private _set(key: string, value: unknown) {
 243| |    const entry = (this.jar[this.name] ??= { ...this.initial });
 244| |    (entry as Record<string, unknown>)[key] = value;
 245| |  }
 246| |}
 248| |// ============================================================================
 249| |// Cookie Jar Factory
 250| |// ============================================================================
 252|▼|export const createCookieJar = (
 253| |  set: SetHeaders,
 254| |  store: Record<string, ElysiaCookie>,
 255| |  initial?: Partial<ElysiaCookie>
 256| |): Record<string, Cookie> => {
 257| |  if (!set.cookie) set.cookie = Object.create(null);
 258| |  return new Proxy(store, {
 259| |    get(_, key: string) {
 260| |      return new Cookie(key, set.cookie!, { ...initial, ...store[key] });
 261| |    }
 262| |  }) as Record<string, Cookie>;
 263| |};
 267| |// ============================================================================
 268| |// Context Factory
 269| |// ============================================================================
 271| |const HDR_JSON = { "content-type": "application/json; charset=utf-8" };
 272| |const HDR_TEXT = { "content-type": "text/plain; charset=utf-8" };
 273| |const HDR_HTML = { "content-type": "text/html; charset=utf-8" };
 275| |let requestIdCounter = 0;
 276|▼|const generateRequestId = (): string => {
 277| |  const ts = performance.now().toString(36).replace(".", "");
 278| |  const seq = (++requestIdCounter).toString(36);
 279| |  return `${ts}-${seq}`;
 280| |};
 282|▼|type FluxHeadersInit =
 283| |  | Headers
 284| |  | Record<string, string | undefined>
 285| |  | [string, string | undefined][];
 287|▼|const isHeaderEntryArray = (
 288| |  value: FluxHeadersInit,
 289| |): value is [string, string | undefined][] => Array.isArray(value);
 291| |/**
 292| | * Merge base headers with optional init headers.
 293| | * Filters undefined header values to satisfy exactOptionalPropertyTypes.
 294| | */
 295|▼|const mergeHeaders = (
 296| |  base: Record<string, string>,
 297| |  init?: FluxHeadersInit,
 298| |): Headers => {
 299| |  const headers = new Headers(base);
 301| |  if (init === undefined) {
 302| |    return headers;
 303| |  }
 305| |  if (init instanceof Headers) {
 306| |    init.forEach((value, key) => {
 307| |      headers.set(key, value);
 308| |    });
 309| |    return headers;
 310| |  }
 312| |  if (isHeaderEntryArray(init)) {
 313| |    for (const [key, value] of init) {
 314| |      if (value !== undefined) {
 315| |        headers.set(key, value);
 316| |      }
 317| |    }
 318| |    return headers;
 319| |  }
 321| |  for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(init)) {
 322| |    if (value !== undefined) {
 323| |      headers.set(key, value);
 324| |    }
 325| |  }
 327| |  return headers;
 328| |};
 330|▼|const createResponseInit = (
 331| |  status: number,
 332| |  headers?: FluxHeadersInit,
 333| |): ResponseInit => {
 334| |  const responseInit: ResponseInit = { status };
 336| |  if (headers !== undefined) {
 337| |    responseInit.headers = mergeHeaders({}, headers);
 338| |  }
 340| |  return responseInit;
 341| |};
 344| |const defaultCache = new HttpResponseCache({ max: 1000, ttlMs: 60_000, staleTtlMs: 300_000 });
 346| |export function createContext<P = Record<string, string>>(
 347| |  req: Request,
 348| |  params: P,
 349| |  opts: ContextOptions = {}
 350| |): FluxContext<P, URLSearchParams> {
 351| |  let _url: URL | undefined;
 352| |  let _query: URLSearchParams | undefined = opts.query;
 354| |  const body = opts.bodyInstance ?? createLazyBody(req, opts.body);
 355| |  const state = new Map<string | symbol, unknown>();
 356| |  const set: SetHeaders = { headers: {}, status: 200, ...opts.set };
 358| |  const cookieStore = parseCookieString(req.headers.get("cookie"));
 359| |  const cookie = createCookieJar(set, cookieStore as any);
 361| |  const ctx: FluxContext<P, URLSearchParams> = {
 362| |    req,
 363| |    get url() { return (_url ??= new URL(req.url)); },
 364| |    method: req.method as HttpMethod,
 365| |    get path() { return this.url.pathname; },
 366| |    route: "",
 367| |    headers: req.headers,
 368| |    requestId: generateRequestId(),
 369| |    startTime: performance.now(),
 370| |    params,
 371| |    get query() { return (_query ??= this.url.searchParams) as URLSearchParams; },
 372| |    body,
 373| |    cookie,
 374| |    state,
 376| |    getState<T = unknown>(key: string | symbol): T | undefined {
 377| |      return state.get(key) as T | undefined;
 378| |    },
 380| |    setState<T>(key: string | symbol, value: T): void {
 381| |      state.set(key, value);
 382| |    },
 383| |    json<T>(data: T, init?: ResponseInit): Response {
 384| |      const status = init?.status ?? set.status ?? 200;
 386| |      return Response.json(data, {
 387| |        status,
 388| |        headers: mergeHeaders(HDR_JSON, init?.headers),
 389| |      });
 390| |    },
 392| |    text(data: string, init?: ResponseInit): Response {
 393| |      const status = init?.status ?? set.status ?? 200;
 395| |      return new Response(data, {
 396| |        status,
 397| |        headers: mergeHeaders(HDR_TEXT, init?.headers),
 398| |      });
 399| |    },
 401| |    html(data: string, init?: ResponseInit): Response {
 402| |      const status = init?.status ?? set.status ?? 200;
 404| |      return new Response(data, {
 405| |        status,
 406| |        headers: mergeHeaders(HDR_HTML, init?.headers),
 407| |      });
 408| |    },
 410| |    stream(stream: ReadableStream, init?: ResponseInit): Response {
 411| |      return new Response(
 412| |        stream,
 413| |        createResponseInit(init?.status ?? 200, init?.headers),
 414| |      );
 415| |    },
 416| |    empty(status = 204): Response {
 417| |      return new Response(null, { status });
 418| |    },
 419| |    status(code: number): Response {
 420| |      return new Response(null, { status: code });
 421| |    },
 423| |    sendFile(path: string, sendOpts: SendFileOptions = {}) {
 424| |      return sendFile(path, { req, ...sendOpts });
 425| |    },
 426|→|    proxy(target: string | URL, proxyOpts: ProxyOptions = {}) {
 427| |      return proxyRequest(target, proxyOpts);
 428| |    },
 429| |    forward(target: string | URL, proxyOpts: ProxyOptions = {}) {
 430| |      return forwardRequest(req, target, proxyOpts);
 431| |    },
 432|→|    cache(factory: () => Promise<Response>, cacheOpts = {}) {
 433| |      return defaultCache.getOrSet(req, factory, cacheOpts);
 434| |    },
 435| |    server: null,
 436| |  };
 438| |  return ctx;
 439| |}

   2| | * Flux Compiler Orchestrator

  12| |  CompilerOptions,

  37|▼|export const createCompilationResult = (
  38| |  optimized: OptimizationResult,
  39| |  analysis: AnalysisResult,
  40| |  elapsedMs: number
  41| |): CompiledRoute => ({
  42| |  staticRoutes: optimized.routes.filter((r) => r.isStatic),
  43| |  dynamicRoutes: optimized.routes.filter((r) => r.isDynamic),
  44| |  modules: analysis.modules,
  45| |  meta: {
  46| |    inlinedHandlers: optimized.meta.inlined,
  47| |    deduplicatedHandlers: optimized.meta.deduplicated,
  48| |    eliminatedRoutes: optimized.meta.eliminated,
  49| |    totalCompileTime: elapsedMs,
  50| |  },
  51| |});
  53|▼|export const runDiscoveryPhase = (
  54| |  opts: CompilerOptions,
  55| |  logger: Logger
  56| |): DiscoveryResult =>
  57| |  logger.time("discovery", () => {
  58| |    const result = runDiscovery(opts, logger);
  60| |    logger.info("discovery complete", {
  61| |      files: result.files.length,
  62| |      modules: result.modules.length,
  63| |    });
  65| |    return result;
  66| |  });
  68|▼|export const runAnalysisPhase = (

  77| |      routes: result.routes.length,
  78| |      hooks: result.hooks.size,
  79| |    });
  81| |    return result;
  82| |  });

  93| |      inlined: result.meta.inlined,

  96| |    });

  99| |  });
 101|▼|export const runCodegenPhase = (
 102| |  optimized: OptimizationResult,
 103| |  analysis: AnalysisResult,
 104| |  opts: CompilerOptions,

 121| |  });

 124| |  code: string,
 125| |  opts: CompilerOptions,

 130| |  });
 132|▼|export class FluxCompiler {
 133| |  constructor(private readonly input: Partial<CompilerOptions> = {}) {}
 135| |  compile(): CompiledRoute {
 136| |    const validated = validateOptions(this.input);
 138| |    if (!validated.ok) {
 139|!|      throw new Error(
 140| |        `Compiler options invalid:\n${validated.error.join("\n")}`
 141| |      );
 142| |    }
 144| |    const opts = validated.value;
 145| |    const logger = consoleLogger();
 146| |    const t0 = performance.now();
 148| |    logger.info("flux compiler started", {
 149| |      target: opts.target,
 150| |      optimizationLevel: opts.optimizationLevel,
 151| |      routesDir: opts.routesDir,
 152| |      outDir: opts.outDir,
 153| |    });
 155| |    const discovery = runDiscoveryPhase(opts, logger);
 156| |    const analysis = runAnalysisPhase(discovery, opts, logger);
 157| |    const optimized = runOptimizationPhase(analysis, opts, logger);
 158| |    const code = runCodegenPhase(optimized, analysis, opts, logger);
 159| |    const outPath = runLinkingPhase(code, opts, logger);
 161| |    const elapsed = performance.now() - t0;
 163| |    logger.info("build complete", {
 164| |      elapsedMs: Number(elapsed.toFixed(2)),
 165| |      outPath,
 166| |    });
 168| |    return createCompilationResult(optimized, analysis, elapsed);
 169| |  }
 170| |}
 172|▼|export function build(opts?: Partial<CompilerOptions>): CompiledRoute {
 173| |  return new FluxCompiler(opts).compile();
 174| |}
 176| |if (import.meta.main) {
 177| |  build();
 178| |}
